Mishneh Torah, Human Dispositions 3: Shemma yomar adam hoil vehakkina vehattaava vehakkavod vechayyotze bahem derech raa hen umotziin et haadam min haolam. efrosh mehen beyoter veetrachek latztzad haacharon. ad shello yochal basar velo yishte yayin velo yissa ishsha velo yeshev bedira naa velo yilbash malbush nae ella hassak vehatztzemer hakkashe vechayyotze bahen kegon kohane haovde kochavim. gam ze derech raa hi veasur lelech bah. hamehallech bederech zo nikra chote. shehare hu omer benazir <small>(Bamidbar 6 11)</small> "vechipper alav measher chata al hannafesh". amru chachamim uma im nazir shello perash ella min hayyayin tzarich kappara hammonea atzmo mikkol davar vedavar al achat kamma vechamma. lefichach tziuu chachamim shello yimna adam atzmo ella middevarim shemmenato hattora bilvad. velo yehe oser atzmo bindarim uvishvuot al devarim hammuttarim. kach amru chachamim lo dayyecha ma sheasra tora ella sheatta oser alecha devarim acherim. uvakkelal hazze ellu shemmitannin tamid enan bederech tova. veasru chachamim sheyyehe adam mesaggef atzmo betaanit. veal kol haddevarim haellu vechayyotze bahen tzivva shelomo veamar <small>(Kohelet 7 16)</small> "al tehi tzaddik harebe veal titchakkam yoter lamma tishshomem":

Tzarich haadam sheyyechavvin libbo vechol maasav kullam leda et hashshem baruch hu bilvad, veyihye shivto vekumo vedibburo hakkol leummat ze haddavar. ketzad? kesheyyissa veyitten o yaase melacha littol sachar, lo yihye belibbo likbotz mamon bilvad, ella yaase devarim haellu kede sheyyimtza devarim shehagguf tzarich lahem meachila ushetiyya vishivat bayit unesiat ishsha. vechen kesheyyochal veyishte veyivol lo yasim belibbo laasot devarim haellu kede lehanot bilvad ad shennimtza sheeno ochel veshote ella hammatok lachech veyivol kede lehanot, ella yasim al libbo sheyyochal veyishte kede lehaverot gufo veevarav bilvad. lefichach lo yochal kol shehachech mitavve kechelev vachamor ella yochal devarim hammoilim lagguf im marim im metukim. velo yochal devarim haraim lagguf af al pi shehen metukim lachech. ketzad? mi shehaya besaro cham lo yochal basar velo devash velo yishte yayin, kainyan sheamar shelomo derech mashal <small>(Mishlei 25 27)</small> "achl devash" vegomer. veshote me hoolashin af al pi shehu mar shennimtza shote veochel derech refua bilvad kede sheyyavri veyaamod shalem hoil vei efshar laadam lichyot ella baachila ushetiyya. vechen kesheyyivol lo yivol ella kede lehaverot gufo uchede lekayyem et hazzera. lefichach eno boel kol zeman sheyyitavve ella kol et sheyyeda shehu tzarich lehotzi shichvat zera kemo derech harfua o lekayyem et hazzera:

Hammanhig atzmo al pi harfua. im sam al libbo sheyyihye kol gufo veevarav shelemim bilvad vesheyyihyu lo banim osin melachto vaamelin letzarko en zo derech tova. ella yasim al libbo sheyyehe gufo shalem vechazak kede shettihye nafsho yeshara ladaat et Adonai. shei efshar sheyyavin veyistakkel bachachmot vehu raev vechole o echad meevarav koev. veyasim al libbo sheyyihye lo ben ulay yihye chacham vegadol beyisrael. nimtza hamehallech bederech zo kol yamav oved et Adonai tamid. afillu beshaa shennose venoten vaafillu beshaa shebboel. mippene shemmachashavto bakkol kede sheyyimtza tzerachav ad sheyyihye gufo shalem laavod et Adonai. vaafillu beshaa shehu yashen im yashen ledaat kede shettanuach dato alav veyanuach gufo kede shello yechele velo yuchal laavod et Adonai vehu chole, nimtzet shena shello avoda lammakom baruch hu. veal inyan ze tziuu chachamim veamru <small>(mishna avot 2 12)</small> "vechol maasecha yihyu leshem shamayim". vehu sheamar shelomo bechachmato <small>(Mishlei 3 6)</small> "bechol derachecha daehu vehu yeyashsher orchotecha":
Mishneh Torah, Human Dispositions 4: Hoil veheyot hagguf bari veshalem middarche hashshem hu. shehare i efshar sheyyavin o yeda davar midiat habbore vehu chole. lefichach tzarich leharechik adam atzmo middevarim hameabbedin et hagguf. ulehanhig atzmo bidvarim hammavrin vehammachalimim. veellu hen: leolam lo yochal adam ella keshehu raev. velo yishte ella keshehu tzame. veal yashhe nekavav afillu rega echad. ella kol zeman shetztzarich lehashetin o lehasech et raglav yaamod miyyad:

Lo yochal adam ad shettitmalle kereso ella yifchot kemo revia missavato. velo yishte mayim betoch hammazon ella meat umazug beyayin. uchesheyyatchil hammazon lehitakkel bemeav shote ma shehu tzarich lishtot. velo yarbe lishtot mayim vaafillu kesheyyitakkel hammazon. velo yochal ad sheyyivdok atzmo yafe yafe shemma yihye tzarich linkavav. lo yochal adam ad sheyyelech kodem achila ad sheyyatchil gufo lachom. o yaase melachto o yityaggea beyega acher. kelalo shel davar yeanne gufo veyiga kol yom babboker ad sheyyatchil gufo lachom veyishkot meat ad shettityashshev nafsho veochel. veim rachatz bechammin achar sheyyaga hare ze tov veachar kach shohe meat veochel:

Leolam kesheyyochal adam yeshev bimkomo o yitte al semol. velo yehallech velo yirkav velo yiga velo yezaazea gufo velo yetayyel ad sheyyitakkel hammazon shebbemeav. vechol hametayyel achar achilato o sheyyagea hare ze mevi al atzmo cholaim raim vekashim:

Hayyom vehallayla 24 shaot. day lo laadam lishon shelishan shehu shemone shaot. veyihyu besof hallayla kede shettihye mittechillat shenato ad shettaale hashshemesh shemone shaot. venimtza omed mimmittato kodem shettaale hashshemesh:

Lo yishan adam lo al panav velo al arpo ella al tziddo. bitchillat hallayla al tzad semol. uvesof hallayla al tzad yamin. velo yishan samuch laachila ella yamtin achar achila kemo shalosh o arba shaot. velo yishan bayyom:

Devarim hameshalshelin et bene meayim kegon anavim uteenim vetutim vaagassim vaavattichim umine hakkishshuim umine melaffonot ochel otam haadam battechilla kodem achila. velo yearvem im hammazon. ella shohe meat ad sheyyetzu mibbeten haelyon veochel mezono. udevarim shemmeammetzin et bene meayim kegon rimmonim uferishim vetappuchim ukerostomolin ochel otan techef limzono. velo yarbe leechol mehen:

Kesheyyirtze adam leechol besar of uvesar behema keechad. ochel battechilla besar haof. vechen betzim uvesar of ochel battechilla betzim. besar behema dakka uvesar behema gassa ochel battechilla besar dakka. leolam yakdim adam davar hakkal umeacher hakkaved:

Bimot hachamma ochel maachalim hakkarim velo yarbe bitvalim veochel et hachometz. uvimot haggeshamim ochel maachalim hachammim umarbe bitvalim veochel meat min hachardal umin hachiltit. veal derech zo holech veose bammekomot hakkarim uvammekomot hachammim bechol makom umakom harauy lo:

Yesh maachalot shehem raim beyoter ad meod verauy laadam shello leachlan leolam. kegon haddagim haggedolim hammeluchim hayeshanim. vehaggevina hammelucha hayeshana. vehakkemehin ufitriyyot vehabbasar hammaliach hayyashan. veyayin miggitto. vetavshil sheshshaha ad shennadaf recho. vechen kol maachol sherecho ra o mar beyoter. hare ellu lagguf kemo sam hammavet. veyesh maachalot shehen raim aval enan kemo harishonim leroa. lefichach rauy laadam shello leechol mehen ella meat veachar yamim harebe. velo yargil atzmo lihyot mezono mehem o leachlan im mezono tamid. kegon dagim gedolim ugevina vechalav sheshshaha achar shennechlav 24 shaot. uvesar shevarim gedolim uteyashim gedolim vehappol vehaadashim vehassappir velechem seorim velechem matztzot vehakkeruv vehechatzir vehabbetzalim vehashshumim vehachardal vehatztzenon. kol ellu maachalim raim hem en rauy laadam leechol meellu ella meat ad meod uvimot haggeshamim. aval bimot hachamma lo yochal mehen kelal. vehappol vehaadashim bilvad en rauy leachlan lo bimot hachamma velo bimot haggeshamim. vehaddeluin ochlin mehen bimot hachamma:

Veyesh maachalot shehem raim veenan kemo ellu. vehem of hammayim uvene yona hakketannim vehattemarim velechem kaluy beshemen o lechem shennillosh beshemen vehassolet shennippu otah kol tzarkah ad shello nishara bah reach muresan. vehatztzir vehammureyays. en rauy leharebot maachalot ellu. veadam shehu chacham vechovesh et yitzro velo yimmashech achar taavato velo yochal min hannizkarim kelum ella im nitzrach lahem lirfua hare ze gibbor:

Leolam yimna adam atzmo mipperot hailanot. velo yarbe mehen vaafillu yeveshin veen tzarich lomar retubbim. aval kodem sheyyitbashshelu kol tzarkan hare hen kacharavot lagguf. vechen hacharuvim raim leolam. vechol happerot hachamutzin raim veen ochlin mehen ella meat bimot hachamma uvammekomot hachammim. vehatteenim vehaanavim vehashshekedim leolam tovim ben retubbin ben yeveshin veochel adam mehem kol tzarko. velo yatmid achilatam af al pi shehen tovim mikkol peri hailanot:
Haddevash vehayyayin ra lakketannim veyafe lazzekenim vechol shekken bimot haggeshamim. vetzarich adam leechol bimot hachamma shene shelishim ma shehu ochel bimot haggeshamim:

Leolam yishtaddel adam sheyyihyu meav rafin kol yamav veyihye karov leshilshul meat. veze kelal gadol barfua kol zeman shehari nimna o yotze bekoshi cholaim raim baim. uvamme yarpe adam meav im yitammetzu meat. im haya bachur yochal babboker babboker meluchim shelukim metubbalin beshemen zayit uvemureyays uvemelach belo pat. o yishte me shelek shel teradin o keruv beshemen zayit umureyays umelach. veim haya zaken yishte devash mazug bemayim chammim babboker veyishhe kemo arba shaot veachar kach yochal seuddato. veyaase chen yom echad o shelosha o arbaa yamim im tzarich lechach ad sheyyirpu meav:
Veod kelal acher amru bivriut hagguf. kol zeman sheadam mitammel veyagea harebe veeno savea umeav rafin en choli ba alav vechocho mitchazzek. vaafillu ochel maachalot haraim:

Vechol mi shehu yoshev lavetach veeno mitammel. o mi shemmashhe nekavav. o mi shemmeav kashin. afillu achal maachalot tovim veshamar atzmo al pi harfua. kol yamav yihyu machovim vechocho tashesh. vaachila gassa leguf kol adam kemo sam hammavet. vehu ikkar lechol hecholaim. verov hecholaim shebbaim al haadam enam ella o mippene maachalim raim. o mippene shehu memalle bitno veochel achila gassa afillu mimmaachalim tovim. hu sheshshelomo amar bechachmato <small>(Mishlei 21 23)</small> "shomer piv uleshono shomer mitztzarot nafsho". kelomar shomer piv milleechol maachol ra o millisboa uleshono milledabber ella bitzrachav:

Derech harchitza. sheyyikkanes adam lammerchatz mishshiva yamim leshiva yamim. velo yikkanes samuch laachila. velo keshehu raev. ella kesheyyatchil hammazon lehitakkel. verochetz kol gufo bechammin sheen hagguf nichve bahen. verosho bilvad bechammin shehagguf nichve bahen. veachar kach yirchatz gufo befoshrin veachar kach befoshrin min happoshrin ad sheyyirchatz betzonen. velo yaavor al rosho mayim lo poshrin velo tzonen. velo yirchatz betzonen bimot haggeshamim. velo yirchatz ad sheyyazzia vifarech kol gufo. velo yaarich bammerchatz ella kesheyyazzia vifarech gufo yishtattef veyetze. uvodek atzmo kodem sheyyikkanes lammerchatz veachar sheyyetze shemma yehe tzarich linkavav. vechen bodek adam atzmo tamid kodem achila veachar achila. vekodem beila veachar beila. vekodem sheyyiga veyitammel veachar sheyyiga veyitammel. vekodem sheyyishan veachar sheyyishan. uveshiur hakkol asara:

Kesheyyetze adam min hammerchatz yilbash begadav vichasse rosho babbayit hachitzon kede shello tishlot bo ruach kara. vaafillu bimot hachamma tzarich lehizzaher. veyishhe achar sheyyetze ad shettityashshev nafsho veyanuach gufo vetasur hachamimut veachar kach yochal. veim yashen meat kesheyyetze min hammerchatz kodem achila hare ze yafe meod. velo yishte mayim karim betzeto min hammerchatz veen tzarich lomar shello yishte bammerchatz. veim tzame kesheyyatza min hammerchatz veeno yachol limnoa atzmo yearev hammayim beyayin o bidvash veyishte. veim sach beshemen bammerchatz bimot haggeshamim achar sheyyishtattef hare ze tov:

Lo yargil adam lehakkiz dam tamid. velo yakkiz ella im yihye tzarich lo beyoter. velo yakkiz lo bimot hachamma velo bimot haggeshamim ella meat bime nisan umeat bime tishre. umeachar chamishshim shana lo yakkiz kelal. velo yakkiz adam dam veyikkanes lammerchatz bo bayyom. velo yakkiz veyetze ladderech. velo beyom sheyyavo min hadderech. veyochal veyishte beyom hahakkaza pachot mimma shehu ragil. veyanuach beyom hahakkaza velo yiga velo yitammel velo yetayyel:

Shichvat zera hi koach hagguf vechayyav umeor haenayim vechol shettetze beyoter hagguf kale vechocho kale vechayyav ovdim. hu sheamar shelomo bechachmato <small>(Mishlei lo 3)</small> "al titten lannashim chelecha". kol hashshatuf bivila zikna kofetzet alav. vechocho tashesh. veenav kehot. vereach ra nodef mippiv umishshechyo. usear rosho vegabbot enav verise enav noshrot. usear zekano veshechyo usear raglav rabbe. shinnav noflot. veharebe keevim chutz meellu baim alav. amru chachme harofim echad meelef met bishar cholaim vehaelef merov hattashmish. lefichach tzarich adam lehizzaher bedavar ze im ratza lichyot betova. velo yivol ella kesheyyimmatze gufo bari vechazak beyoter vehu mitkashshe harebe shello ledato. umassiach atzmo ledavar acher vehakkishshuy bo keshehaya. veyimmatze koved mimmatnav ulematta ucheillu chute habbetzim nimshachim uvesaro cham. ze tzarich livol urefua lo sheyyivol. lo yivol adam vehu savea velo raev ella achar sheyyitakkel hammazon shebbemeav. veyivdok nekavav kodem beila uleachar beila. velo yivol meummad velo meyushshav. velo bevet hammerchatz velo beyom sheyyikkanes lammerchatz. velo beyom hakkaza. velo beyom yetzia ladderech o bia min hadderech lo lifnehem velo leacharehem:

Kol hammanhig atzmo bidrachim ellu shehorinu ani arev lo sheeno ba lide choli kol yamav ad sheyyazkin harebe veyamut veeno tzarich lerofe. veyihye gufo shalem veomed al buryo kol yamav. ella im ken haya gufo ra mittechillat beriyyato. o im haya ragil beminhag min hamminhagot haraim mittechillat moladto. o im tavo makkat dever o makkat batztzoret laolam:

Vechol hamminhagot hattovim haellu sheamarnu en rauy linhog bahen ella habbari. aval hachole o mi sheechad meevarav chole o mi shennahag minhag ra shanim rabbot. yesh lechol echad mehem derachim acherim vehanehagot kefi chalyo kemo sheyyitbaer besefer harfuot. veshinnuy veset techillat choli:
Kol makom sheen bo rofe. echad habbari veechad hachole en rauy lo lazuz mikkol hadderachim haellu shenneemru beferek ze. shekkol echad mehen leacharit tova mevi:

Kol ir sheen bah asara devarim haellu en talmid chacham rashshay ladur betochah. veellu hen: rofe. veumman. uvet hammerchatz. uvet hakkisse. umayim metzuyin kegon nahar umayan. uvet hakkeneset. umelammed tinokot. velavlar. vegabbay tzedaka. uvet din makkim vechovshim:
Mishneh Torah, Human Dispositions 5: Keshem shehechacham nikkar bechachmato uvedeotav vehu muvdal bahem mishshear haam. kach tzarich sheyyihye nikkar bemaasav bemaachalo uvemashkehu uvivilato uvaasiyyat tzerachav uvedibburo uvehillucho uvemalbusho uvechilkul devarav uvemassao uvemattano. veyihyu kol hammaasim haellu naim umetukkanim beyoter. ketzad. talmid chacham lo yihye gargeran ella ochel maachol harauy lehaverot gufo. velo yochal mimmennu achila gassa. velo yehe rodef lemalleot bitno keellu shemmitmallein mimmaachol umishte ad shettippach keresam. vaalehem meforash bakkabbala <small>(Malachi 2 3)</small> "vezeriti feresh al penechem". amru chachamim ellu bene adam sheochlin veshotin veosin kol yemehem kechaggim. vehem haomrim <small>(yeshaya 22 13)</small> "achol veshato ki machar namut". vezehu maachal harshaim. veshulchanot ellu hem shegginna hakkatuv veamar <small>(yeshaya koach 8)</small> "ki kol shulchanot malu ki tzoa beli makom". aval hechacham eno ochel ella tavshil echad o shenayim veochel mimmennu kede chayyav vedayyo. hu sheamar shelomo <small>(Mishlei 13 25)</small> "tzaddik ochel lesova nafsho":

Keshehechacham ochel meat ze harauy lo lo yochlennu ella beveto al shulchano. velo yochal bachanut velo bashshuk ella mippene tzorech gadol. kede shello yitganne bifne habberiyyot. velo yochal etzel amme haaretz velo al otan hashshulchanot hammeleim ki tzoa. velo yarbe seuddotav bechol makom vaafillu im hachachamim. velo yochal bisuddot sheyyesh bahen kibbutz harebe. veen rauy lo leechol ella bisudda shel mitzva bilvad kegon seuddat erusin venissuin. vehu sheyyihye talmid chacham shennasa bat talmid chacham. vehatztzaddikim vehachasidim harishonim lo achlu misseudda sheenah shellahen:

Keshehechacham shote yayin eno shote ella kede lishrot achila shebbemeav. vechol hammishtakker hare ze chote umegunne umafsid chachmato. veim nishtakker bifne amme haaretz hare ze chillel et hashshem. veasur lishtot yayin batztzohorayim vaafillu meat ella im haya bichlal haachila. shehashshetiyya shehi bichlal haachila enah meshakkeret. veen nizharin ella miyyayin shelleachar hammazon:

Af al pi sheishto shel adam mutteret lo tamid. rauy lo letalmid chacham sheyyanhig atzmo bikdushsha velo yehe matzuy etzel ishto ketarnegol ella millele shabbat lelele shabbat im yesh bo koach. ucheshehu mesapper immah lo yesapper bitchillat hallayla keshehu savea uvitno male. velo besof hallayla keshehu raev. ella beemtza hallayla kesheyyitakkel hammazon shebbemeav. velo yakel berosho beyoter velo yenabbel et piv bedivre havay vaafillu beno levenah. hare hu omer bekabbala maggid leadam ma secho. amru chachamim afillu sicha kalla shebben adam leishto atid litten aleha et haddin. velo yihyu shenehem lo shikkorim velo atzlanim velo atzbanim, velo echad mehen. velo tihye yeshena. velo yeenos otah vehi enah rotza ella birtzon shenehem uvesimchatam. yesapper veyischak meat immah kede shettityashshev nafshah veyivol bevusha velo beazzut veyifrosh miyyad:

Kol hannoheg minhag ze lo day lo shekkiddesh nafsho vetiher atzmo vetikken deotav ella sheim hayu lo banim yihyu naim uvayshanim reuyin lechachma velachasidut. vechol hannoheg beminhagot shear haam haholchim bachoshech yihyu lo banim kemo otam haam:

Tzeniut gedola nohagim talmide chachamim beatzman. lo yitbazzu velo yitgallu roshan velo gufan. vaafillu beshaa sheyyikkanes levet hakkisse yehe tzanua velo yegalle begadav ad sheyyeshev. velo yekanneach beyamin. veyitrachek mikkol adam. veyikkanes cheder lifnim mecheder meara lifnim min hammeara venifne. veim nifne achore haggader yitrachek kede shello yishma chavero kolo im nitattesh. veim nifne bevika yarchik kede shello yire chavero peruo. velo yedabber keshehu nifne afillu letzorech gadol. uchederech shennoheg tzeniut bayyom bevet hakkisse kach noheg ballayla. uleolam yelammed adam atzmo lehippanot shacharit vearvit bilvad kede shello yitrachek:

Talmid chacham lo yehe tzoek vetzoveach bishat dibburo kivhemot vechayyot. velo yagbiah kolo beyoter ella dibburo benachat im kol habberiyyot. uchesheyyedabber benachat yizzaher shello yitrachek ad sheyyerae kedivre gasse haruach. umakdim shalom lechol haadam kede shettehe ruchan nocha hemennu. vedan et kol haadam lechaf zechut. mesapper beshevach chavero velo bignuto kelal. ohev shalom verodef shalom. im roe sheddevarav moilim venishmaim omer veim lav shotek. ketzad. lo yeratztze chavero bishat kaaso. velo yishal lo al nidro beshaa shennadar ad shettitkarer dato veyanuach. velo yenachamennu beshaa shemmeto muttal lefanav mippene shehu bahul ad sheyyikberehu. vechen kol kayyotze beellu. velo yire lachavero bishat kalkalato ella yaalim enav mimmennu. velo yeshanne bedibburo. velo yosif velo yigra ella bedivre shalom vechayyotze bahen. kelalo shel davar eno medabber ella bedivre chachma o bigmilut chasadim vechayyotze bahen. velo yesapper im ishsha bashshuk vaafillu hi ishto o achoto o bitto:

Lo yelech talmid chacham bekoma zekufa vegaron natuy kainyan shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 3 16)</small> "vattelachna netuyot garon umesakkerot enayim". velo yehallech akev betzad gudal benachat kemo hannashim vegasse haruach kainyan shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 3 16)</small> "haloch vetafof telachna uveraglehem teakkasna". velo yarutz birshut harabbim keminhag meshuggaim. velo yichpof komato kevaale chatoteret. ella mistakkel lematta kemo shehu omed bitfilla. umehallech bashshuk keadam shehu tarud baasakav. gam mimmahalacho shel adam nikkar im chacham uvaal dea hu o shote vesachol. vechen amar shelomo bechachmato <small>(Kohelet 10 3)</small> "vegam badderech keshessachol holech libbo chaser veamar lakkol sachol hu". hu modia lakkol al atzmo shehu sachol:

Malbush talmid chacham malbush nae venaki. veasur lo sheyyimmatze bevigdo ketem o shamnunit vechayyotze bahen. velo yilbash lo malbush melachim kegon bigde zahav veargaman shehakkol mistakkelin bahen. velo malbush aniyyim shehu mevazze et lovshav ella begadim benonim naim. velo yehe besaro nire mittachat maddav kemo bigde happishtan hakkallim beyoter sheosim bemitzrayim. velo yihyu begadav sechuvin al haaretz kemo bigde gasse haruach ella ad akevo uvet yad shello ad rashe etzbeotav. velo yeshalshel tallito mippene shennire kegassut haruach ella beshabbat bilvad im en lo lehachalif. velo yinal minalim metullaim telay al gabbe telay bimot hachamma. aval bimot haggeshamim muttar im haya ani. lo yetze mevussam lashshuk velo bivgadim mevussamim velo yasim boshom bisaro. aval im mashach besaro bevoshom kede lehaavir et hazzuhama muttar. vechen lo yetze yechidi ballayla. ella im ken haya lo zeman kavua latzet bo letalmudo. kol ellu mippene hachashad:

Talmid chacham mechalkel devarav bemishpat. ochel veshote vezan et anshe beto kefi mamono vehatzelachato. velo yatriach al atzmo yoter midday. tziuu chachamim bederech eretz shello yochal adam basar ella leteavon. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 20)</small> "ki teavve nafshecha leechol basar". dayyo labbari leechol basar meerev shabbat leerev shabbat. veim haya ashir kede leechol basar bechol yom ochel. tziuu chachamim veamru leolam yochal adam pachot min harauy lo lefi mamono veyilbash karauy lo vichabbed ishto uvanav yoter min harauy lo:

Derech baale dea sheyyikba lo adam melacha hamefarneset oto techilla. veachar kach yikne bet dira. veachar kach yissa ishsha. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20 6)</small> "mi haish asher nata kerem velo chillelo". <small>(Devarim 20 5)</small> "mi haish asher bana vayit chadash velo chanacho". <small>(Devarim 20 7)</small> "mi haish asher eras ishsha velo lekachah". aval hattippeshin matchilin lissa ishsha veachar kach im timtza yado yikne bayit veachar kach besof yamav yechazzer levakkesh ummanut o yitparnes min hatztzedaka. vechen hu omer bakkelalot <small>(Devarim 28 30)</small> "ishsha teares" <small>(Devarim 28 30)</small> "bayit tivne" <small>(Devarim 28 30)</small> "kerem titta". kelomar yihyu maasecha hafuchin kede shello tatzliach et derachecha. uvabberacha hu omer <small>(Shmuel 1 18 14)</small> "vayhi david lechol derachav maskil vaAdonai immo":

Veasur lo laadam lehafekir o lehakedish kol nechasav veyatriach al habberiyyot. velo yimkor sade veyikne bayit velo bayit veyikne mittaltelin o yaase sechora bidme beto. aval mocher hu mittaltelin vekone sade. kelalo shel davar yasim megammato lehatzeliach nechasav ulehachalif hakkale bekayyam. velo tihye kavvanato lehanot meat lefi shaa o lehanot meat veyafsid harebe:

Massao umattano shel talmid chacham beemet uveemuna. omer al lav lav veal hen hen. medakdek al atzmo becheshbon venoten umevatter laacherim kesheyyikkach mehen velo yedakdek alehen. venoten deme hammikkach lealtar veeno naase lo arev velo kabbelan velo yavo behareshaa. (eno) mechayyev atzmo bedivre mikkach umimkar bemakom shello chiyyeva oto tora. kede sheyyaamod bedibburo velo yeshannehu. veim nitchayyevu lo acherim baddin maarich umochel lahen umalve vechonen. velo yered letoch ummanut chavero. velo yatzer leadam leolam bechayyav. kelalo shel davar yihye min hannirdafim velo min harodfim min hanneelavim velo min haolvim. veadam sheose kol hammaasim haellu vechayyotze bahen alav hakkatuv omer vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar:
Mishneh Torah, Human Dispositions 6: Derech beriyyato shel adam lihyot nimshach bedeotav uvemaasav achar reav vachaverav venoheg keminhag anshe medinato. lefichach tzarich adam lehitchabber latztzaddikim vileshev etzel hachachamim tamid kede sheyyilmad mimmaasehem. viyitirachek min harshaim haholchim bachoshech kede shello yilmod mimmaasehem. hu sheshshelomo omer <small>(Mishlei 13 20)</small> "holech et chachamim yechkam veroe chesilim yeroa". veomer ashre haish vegomer. vechen im haya bimdina shemminhagoteha raim veen anasheha holchim bederech yeshara yelech lemakom sheanasheha tzaddikim venohagim bederech tovim. veim hayu kol hammedinot shehu yodam veshomea shemuatan nohagim bederech lo tova kemo zemannenu. o sheeno yachol lalechet limdina shemminhagoteha tovim mippene haggeyasot o mippene hacholi yeshev levaddo yechidi kainyan shenneemar <small>(Eicha 3 28)</small> "yeshev badad veyiddom". veim hayu raim vechattaim sheen menichim oto leshev bammedina ella im ken nitarev immahen venoheg beminhagam hara yetze lammearot velachavachim velammidbarot. veal yanhig atzmo bederech chattaim kainyan shenneemar <small>(yirmeya 9 1)</small> "mi yitteneni vammidbar melon orchim":

Mitzvat ase lehiddavek bachachamim vetalmidehem kede lilmod mimmaasehem kainyan shenneemar uvo tidbak. vechi efshar laadam lehiddavek bashshechina. ella kach amru chachamim beferush mitzva zo, hiddavek bachachamim vetalmidehem. lefichach tzarich adam lehishtaddel sheyyissa bat talmid chacham veyassi bitto letalmid chacham veleechol velishtot im talmide chachamim velaasot perakmatya letalmid chacham ulehitchabber lahen bechol mine chibbur shenneemar uledavka bo. vechen tziuu chachamim veamru <small>(mishna avot 1 4)</small> "veheve mitabbek baafar raglehem veshote batztzama et divrehem":

Mitzva al kol adam leehov et kol echad veechad miyyisrael kegufo shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 18)</small> "veahavta lereacha kamocha". lefichach tzarich lesapper beshivcho velachus al mamono kaasher hu chas al mamon atzmo verotze bichvod atzmo. vehammitkabbed biklon chavero en lo chelek laolam habba:

Ahavat hagger shebba venichnas tachat kanfe hashshechina shete mitzvot ase. achat mippene shehu bichlal reim veachat mippene shehu ger vehattora amra <small>(Devarim 10 19)</small> "vaahavtem et hagger". tzivva al ahavat hagger kemo shetztzivva al ahavat atzmo shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 5)</small> "veahavta et Adonai elohecha". hakkadosh baruch hu atzmo ohev gerim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 10 18)</small> "veohev ger":

Kol hassone echad miyyisrael belibbo over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 17)</small> "lo tisna et achicha bilvavecha". veen lokin al lav ze lefi sheen bo maase. velo hizhira tora ella al sina shebballev. aval hammakke et chavero vehamecharfo af al pi sheeno rashshay eno over mishshum lo tisna:

Kesheyyechta ish leish lo yistemennu veyishtok kemo shenneemar barshaim <small>(Shmuel 2 13 22)</small> "velo dibber avshalom et amnon meuma lemera vead tov ki sane avshalom et amnon". ella mitzva alav lehodio velomar lo lamma asita li kach vechach velamma chatata li bedavar peloni. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 17)</small> "hocheach tochiach et amitecha". veim chazar uvikkesh mimmennu limchol lo tzarich limchol. velo yehe hammochel achzari shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 20 17)</small> "vayyitpallel avraham el haelohim":

Haroe chavero shechata o shehalach bederech lo tova mitzva lehachaziro lammutav ulehodio shehu chote al atzmo bemaasav haraim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 17)</small> "hocheach tochiach et amitecha". hammochiach et chavero. ben bidvarim shebbeno leveno. ben bidvarim shebbeno leven hammakom. tzarich lehochicho beno leven atzmo. vidabber lo benachat uvelashon rakka veyodio sheeno omer lo ella letovato lahavio lechayye haolam habba. im kibbel mimmennu mutav veim lav yochichennu paam sheniyya ushelishit. vechen tamid chayyav adam lehochicho ad sheyyakkehu hachote veyomar lo eni shomea. vechol sheefshar beyado limchot veeno moche hu nitpas baavon ellu kevan sheefshar lo limchot bahem:

Hammochiach et chavero techilla lo yedabber lo kashot ad sheyyachlimennu shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 17)</small> "velo tissa alav chet". kach amru chachamim yachol atta mochicho ufanav mishtannot talmud lomar velo tissa alav chet. mikkan sheasur laadam lehachelim et yisrael vechol shekken barabbim. af al pi shehammachlim et chavero eno loke alav avon gadol hu. kach amru chachamim <small>(gemara sanhedrin 107 1)</small> "hammalbin pene chavero barabbim en lo chelek laolam habba". lefichach tzarich adam lehizzaher shello levayyesh chavero barabbim ben katan ben gadol. velo yikra lo beshem shehu bosh mimmennu. velo yesapper lefanav davar shehu bosh mimmennu. bamme devarim amurim bidvarim shebben adam lachavero. aval bedivre shamayim im lo chazar bo basseter machlimin oto barabbim umefarsemim cheto umecharfim oto befanav umevazzin umekallelin oto ad sheyyachazor lammutav kemo sheasu kol hanneviim beyisrael:

Mi shechata alav chavero velo ratza lehochicho velo ledabber lo kelum mippene shehaya hachote hedyot beyoter. o shehayta dato meshubbeshet. umachal lo belibbo velo setamo velo hochicho hare zo middat chasidut. lo hikpida tora ella al hammastema:

Chayyav adam lehizzaher bitomim vealmanot mippene shennafshan shefala limod verucham nemucha af al pi shehen baale mamon. afillu almanato shel melech vitomav muzharim anu alehen shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 21)</small> "kol almana veyatom lo teannun". veheach nohagin immahen. lo yedabber alehem ella rakkot. velo yinhog bahen ella minhag kavod. velo yachiv gufam baavoda velibbam bidvarim kashim. veyachus al mamonam yoter mimmamon atzmo. kol hammaknitan o machisan o hichiv lahen o rada bahen o ibbed mamonan hare ze over belo taase vechol shekken hammakke otam o hamekallelan. velav ze af al pi sheen lokin alav hare ansho meforash battora <small>(Shemot 22 23)</small> "vechara appi veharagti etchem becharev". berit karat lahen mi sheamar vehaya haolam shekkol zeman shehem tzoakim mechamas hem naanim shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 22)</small> "ki im tzaok yitzak elay shamoa eshma tzaakato". bamme devarim amurim bizman sheinna otan letzorech atzmo. aval inna otam harav kede lelammedan tora o ummanut o leholichan bederech yeshara hare ze muttar. veaf al pi chen lo yinhog bahen minhag kol adam ella yaase lahem hefresh vinahalem benachat uverachamim gedolim vechavod shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 22 23)</small> "ki Adonai yariv rivam". echad yatom meav veechad yatom meem. vead ematay nikraim yetomim leinyan ze. ad shello yihyu tzerichin leadam gadol lehissamech alav uleamnan ulehittafel bahen ella yihye ose kol tzarche atzmo leatzmo kishar kol haggedolim:
Mishneh Torah, Human Dispositions 7: Hameraggel bachavero over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 16)</small> "lo telech rachil beammecha". veaf al pi sheen lokin al davar ze avon gadol hu vegorem laharog nefashot rabbot miyyisrael. lechach nismach lo <small>(Vayikra 19 16)</small> "velo taamod al dam reecha". tze ulemad ma era ledoeg haadomi:

E zehu rachil. ze shettoen devarim veholech mizze laze veomer kach amar peloni kach vechach shamati al peloni. af al pi shehu emet hare ze machariv et haolam. yesh avon gadol mizze ad meod vehu bichlal lav ze vehu lashon hara. vehu hamesapper bignut chavero af al pi sheomer emet. aval haomer sheker nikra motzi shem ra al chavero. aval baal lashon hara ze sheyyoshev veomer kach vechach asa peloni vechach vechach hayu avotav vechach vechach shamati alav veamar devarim shel genay. al ze amar hakkatuv <small>(Tehillim 12 4)</small> "yachret Adonai kol sifte chalakot lashon medabberet gedolot":

Amru chachamim shalosh averot nifrain min haadam baolam hazze veen lo chelek laolam habba. avodat kochavim vegilluy arayot ushefichut damim. velashon hara keneged kullam. veod amru chachamim kol hamesapper belashon hara keillu kofer baikkar. shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 12 5)</small> "asher amru lilshonenu nagbir sefatenu ittanu mi adon lanu". veod amru chachamim shelosha lashon hara horeget. haomro. vehamekabbelo. veze sheomer alav. vehamekabbelo yoter min haomro:

Veyesh devarim shehen avak lashon hara. ketzad. mi yomar lifloni sheyyihye kemot shehu atta. o sheyyomar shitku mippeloni eni rotze lehodia ma era ume haya. vechayyotze baddevarim haellu. vechol hamesapper betovat chavero bifne sonav hare ze avak lashon hara shezze gorem lahem sheyyesapperu bignuto. veal ze hainyan amar shelomo <small>(Mishlei 27 14)</small> "mevarech reehu bekol gadol babboker hashekem kelala techashev lo". shemmittoch tovato ba lide raato. vechen hamesapper belashon hara derech sechok vederech kallut rosh kelomar sheeno medabber besina. hu sheshshelomo amar bechachmato <small>(Mishlei 26 18)</small> "kemitlahleah hayyore zikkim chitztzim vamavet" <small>(Mishlei 26 19)</small> "veamar halo mesachek ani". vechen hamesapper lashon hara derech rammaut vehu sheyyesapper letummo keillu eno yodea sheddavar ze sheddibber lashon hara hu ella keshemmemachin bo omer eni yodea sheddavar ze lashon hara o sheellu maasav shel peloni:

Echad hamesapper belashon hara bifne chavero o shello befanav, vehamesapper devarim sheggormim im nishmeu ish mippi ish lehazzik chavero begufo o bemamono, vaafillu lehatzer lo o lehafechido, hare ze lashon hara. veim neemru devarim ellu bifne shelosha kevar nishma haddavar venoda. veim sipper haddavar echad min hashshelosha paam acheret en bo mishshum lashon hara. vehu shello yitkavven lehaavir hakkol ulegalloto yoter:
Kol ellu hem baale lashon hara sheasur ladur bishchunatam vechol shekken leshev immahem velishmoa divrehem. velo nechtam gezar din al avotenu bammidbar ella al lashon hara levad:

Hannokem mechavero over belo taase shenneemar lo tikkom. veaf al pi sheeno loke alav dea raa hi ad meod. ella rauy lo laadam lihyot maavir al middotav al kol divre haolam shehakkol etzel hammevinim divre hevel vahavay veenan keday linkom alehem. ketzad hi hannekima. amar lo chavero hasheileni kardumcha, amar lo eni mashilcha. lemachar tzarich lishol mimmennu, amar lo chavero hasheileni kardumcha, amar lo eni mashilcha kederech shello hishaltani kesheshshaalti mimmecha, hare ze nokem. ella kesheyyavo lo lishol yitten belev shalem velo yigmol lo kaasher gemalo. vechen kol kayyotze baellu. vechen amar david bedeotav hattovot <small>(Tehillim 7 5)</small> "im gamalti sholmi ra vaachalletza" vegomer:

Vechen kol hannoter leechad miyyisrael over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 18)</small> "velo tittor et bene ammecha". ketzad hi hannetira. reuven sheamar leshimon haseker li bayit ze o hasheileni shor ze velo ratza shimon. leyamim ba shimon liruven lishol mimmennu o liskor mimmennu veamar lo reuven he lecha hareni mashilcha veeni kemotcha lo ashallem lecha kemaasecha. haose kaze over belo tittor. ella yimche haddavar millibbo velo yitterennu. shekkol zeman shehu noter et haddavar vezochro shemma yavo linkom. lefichach hikpida tora al hannetira ad sheyyimche heavon millibbo velo yizkerennu kelal. vezo hi haddea hannechona sheefshar sheyyitkayyem bah yishshuv haaretz umassaam umattanam shel bene adam ze im ze:
Mishneh Torah, Immersion Pools 1: Kol hattemein ben adam ben kelim ben shennitmeu tuma chamura shel tora ben shennitmeu betuma shel divrehen en lahen tohora ella bitvila bemayim hannikvin bekarka:

Kol makom shenneemar battora rechitzat basar vechibbus begadim min hattuma eno ella tevilat kol hagguf bemikve. veze shenneemar bezav <small>(Vayikra 15 11)</small> "veyadav lo shataf bammayim" kelomar sheyyitbol kol gufo. vehu haddin lishar hattemein sheim taval kullo chutz merosh etzba hakketanna adayin hu betumato. vechol haddevarim haelle af al pi shehen mippi hashshemua hare neemar <small>(Vayikra 11 32)</small> "bammayim yuva vetame ad haerev vetaher" binyan av lechol hattemeim sheyyavou bammayim:

Kol hakkelim shennitmeu yesh lahen tohora bemikve chutz mikkele cheres uchele zechuchit vechen hammappatz. keli cheres neemar bo <small>(Vayikra 11 33)</small> "veoto tishboru "veen lo tohora ella shevira. afillu chibbero bekarka vaafillu kevao bemasmer vaafillu milleahu sid o gefasim hare hu kemo shehaya ad sheyyishshaver. uchele zechuchit kichle cheres asaum bedavar ze:

Hammappatz eno bichlal hakkelim hamekabbelim shear kol hattumot lefi sheeno keli kibbul eno mikkelal kele etz haamurin battora vehoil vehu rauy lemishkav nitrabba letumat midras bilvad din tora. vechevan sheen lo tuma vetahara beferush venitrabba lattuma lo yitrabbe letaher bemikve sheen mittaher bemikve ella hakkelim haamurin battora veen lammappatz tohora ella keriato ad sheyyishshaer pachot mishshishsha al shishsha tefachim:
Hazzav en lo tohora ella bemayan shehare neemar bo <small>(Vayikra 15 13)</small> "bemayim chayyim" aval hazzava ushear hattemein ben adam ben kelim tovlin af bemikve:

Kol chayyave tevilot tevilatan bayyom chutz minnidda veyoledet shettevilatan ballayla kemo shebbearnu beinyan nidda. uvaal keri tovel veholech kol hayyom kullo mittechillat hallayla shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 12)</small> "vehaya lifnot erev yirchatz bammayim" melammed shettovel veholech mittechillat hallayla ad haarev shemesh:

Kol hattovel tzarich sheyyitbol kol gufo keshehu arum bevat achat. veim haya baal sear yatbil kol sear rosho vahare hu kegufo din tora. vechol hattemein shettavlu bevigdehen alta lahen tevila mippene shehammayim bain bahen veenan chotztzin. vechen hannidda shettavla bivgadeha mutteret levaalah:

Kol hattovel tzarich lehitkavven litvila veim lo nitkavven alta lo tevila lechullin. afillu nidda shettavla belo kavvana kegon shennafla letoch hammayim o yarda lehaker hare zo mutteret levaalah. aval litruma ulekadashim enah tehora ad shettitbol bechavvana:

Hakkofet yadav veraglav veyashav lo beammat hammayim im nichnesu mayim derech kullo tahor. hakkofetz letoch hammikve hare ze megunne. vehattovel paamayim bammikve hare ze megunne. vehaomer lachavero kevosh yadcha alay bammikve hare ze megunne:

Bet hassetarim uvet hakkematim enan tzerichin sheyyavou bahen hammayim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 11)</small> "veyadav lo shataf bammayim" evarim hannirim bilvad. veaf al pi chen tzerichin lihyot reuyin sheyyavou bahen hammayim velo yihye davar chotzetz lefichach amru chachamim leolam yilmod adam betoch beto shettihye ishsha medicha ben kemateha bemayim veachar kach titbol. vehaishsha tovelet kederech gedilatah keoreget uchemenika et benah:

Ishsha enah tovelet bannamel mippene shemmitbayyeshet mibbene hair veenah tovelet kahogen. veim hikkif lah mappatz vechayyotze bo kede lehatzeniah tovelet bannamel. velo titbol al gabbe keli cheres o sal vechayyotze bahen mippene shemmefachedet velo taale lah tevila:

Echad haadam o hakkelim lo yihye davar chotzetz benam uven hammayim. veim haya davar chotzetz benam uven hammayim kegon shehaya batzek o tit mudbak al besar haadam o al guf hakkeli hare ze tame keshehaya velo alta lahen tevila. devar tora im haya davar hachotzetz chofe et rov haadam o rov hakkeli lo alta lahen tevila vehu sheyyakpid alav verotze lehaaviro. aval im eno makpid alav velo sam oto al lev ben avar ben lo avar eno chotzetz veaf al pi shechofe et rubbo. vechen im haya chofe miuto eno chotzetz af al pi shehu makpid alav. middivre sofrim shekkol davar hachotzetz im haya makpid alav lo alta lo tevila af al pi shehu al miuto gezera mishshum rubbo. vechol davar hachotzetz im haya chofe et rubbo lo alta lo tevila af al pi sheeno makpid alav gezera mishshum rubbo hammakpid alav. nimtzeta omer sheim haya al besar haadam o al guf hakkeli davar middevarim hachotztzin kegon batzek vezefet vechayyotze bahen afillu tippa kechardal vehu makpid alav lo alta lo tevila. veim eno makpid alav alta lo tevila. ella im ken haya chofe rov hakkeli o rov haadam kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Immersion Pools 2: Elu chotztzin baadam. lifluf shechutz laayin. vegeled shechutz lammakka. vehaddam yavesh sheal gabbe hammakka. vehartiyya shealeha. vegilde tzoa sheal besaro. uvatzek o tit shettachat hatztzipporen. vehammilmulin sheal hagguf. vetit hayyaven vetit hayyotzrim vetit shel derachim hannimtza sham tamid afillu bimot hachamma kol ellu chotztzin. ushear kol hattit keshehu lach eno chotzetz shehare nimcha bemayim ucheshehu yavesh chotzetz:

Haddevash. vehaddeyo. vehechalav. vehaddam. useraf hattut. vehatteena. vehashshikma. vehecharuv. yeveshin chotztzin lachin enan chotztzin. ushear kol hasserafin ben lachin ben yeveshin chotztzin. vedam shennisrach babbasar afillu lach chotzetz. haever vehabbasar hameduldalim chotztzin:
Bet hassetarim beishsha chotzetz ad shettadiach techilla. shehazzea sham tamid veheavak mitkabbetz vechotzetz. bamme devarim amurim binsua. aval bifnuya hoil veenah makpedet eno chotzetz:
Haeged sheal gabbe hammakka. vehakkaskassin sheal gabbe hashshever. vehashsherim vehannezamim vehakkatlayot vehattabbaot. bizman shehen chazakim udevukim babbasar chotztzim. rafim enam chotztzin:

Chute tzemer vechute pishtan vehartzuot shekkoshrot hannashim berashehen lenoy chotztzin mippene shemmavdilin ben hagguf uven hammayim. aval chute sear en chotztzin mippene shehammayim bain bahen af al pi sheenan rafin:

Chutin shebbatztzavvar enan chotztzin afillu shel pishtan lefi sheen ishsha choneket atzmah bahen. aval chavakim shebbatztzavvar kegon katlayot vaanakim chotztzin lefi shehaishsha choneket atzmah bahen kede shetterae baalat basar:
Sear sheal hallev shennitkashsher venaasa kilkin. vechen kilke hazzakan chotztzin:

Chetz hattachuv beadam bizman shehu nire chotzetz. uvazzeman sheeno nire tovel veochel bitrumato laerev af al pi shehu chetz tame. vechen mi shebbala tabbaat tame vetaval hare ze tahor. veim hekiah achar shettaval nitma bemaggaah shekkevar bearnu shekkol habbeluim beguf hachay lo metammein velo mittammein. nichnesu tzerorot vekesamin besidke raglav millematta chotztzin:

Ispelanit melugema uretiyya sheal bet hassetarim chotztzin. af al pi sheeno tzarich sheyyikkansu bahen hammayim tzerichin sheyyihyu reuyin velo yehe bahen davar chotzetz kemo shebbearnu. hayta bo seara achat o shetayim chutz lammakka veroshah mudbak lammakka o shehayu shete searot rosham mudbak betit o betzoa o shehayu shete searot berise enav millematta unekavan vehotzian berise enav millemala hare ellu chotztzin:
Lo yitbol adam beafar sheal raglav veim taval eno chotzetz:
Haochez beadam uvechelim vehitbilan hare hen betumatan. veaf al pi sherippa yadav ad shebbau bahen hammayim gezera shemma lo yarpe. veim hediach yadav bammayim alta lahen tevila:
Hammafshelet benah laachorah vetavla lo alta lah tevila shemma haya tit beragle hattinok o beyadav venidbak beimmo bishat tevila vechatzatz veachar shealta nafal:

Nidda shennatna searah befiha o shekkaftza yadah o shekkartza besiftoteha o shennimtza etzem ben shinneha keillu lo tavla. vechen shear kol hattemeim. natna maot befiha veyarda vetavla tahara mittumat hannidda vahare hi temea al gav rukka venimtzet rishon letuma kemi shennaga berok hannidda. vechen haddin bezav:

Veellu sheen chotztzin beadam. kilke harosh uvet hashshechi uvet hassetarim shebbaish. velifluf shebbaayin. vegeled sheheelta hammakka. velichluche tzoa sheal besaro. vetzoa shettachat hatztzipporen. vetzipporen hameduldelet. ucheshut hakkatan vehu hassear haddak sheal besaro. kol ellu enan chotztzin:

Shete searot o yeter shehayu keshurin keachat kesher echad enan chotztzin mippene shehammayim bain bahen. useara achat shennikshera chotzetzet vehu sheyyihye makpid aleha. aval im eno makpid aleha alta lo tevila ad shettihye rov searo kashur nima nima bifne atzmo kaze horu haggeonim. veyerae li shessearo shel adam kegufo hu chashuv leinyan tevila veeno keguf bifne atzmo kede shennomar rov hassear ella af al pi shekkol sear rosho kashur nima nima im eno makpid alav alta lo tevila ella im ken nitztaref lechotzetz acher al gufo venimtza hakkol rov gufo kemo shebbearnu. veechad hannidda veechad shear hattemein sheyyesh beroshan sear:

Takkanat ezra hi shettihye ishsha chofefet et searah veachar kach titbol. veim efshar lah lachof ballayla velitbol miyyad techef lachafifa hare ze meshubbach. uvishat haddechak o mippene hacholi chofefet afillu beerev shabbat vetovelet lemotzae shabbat:
Tavla vealta venimtza aleha davar chotzetz im beoto hayyom shechaffa tavla enah tzericha lachof paam sheniyya ella chozeret vetovelet miyyad bilvad. veim lav tzericha lachof paam sheniyya velitbol:

Lo tachof ishsha beneter mippene shemmekattef et hassear. velo beohel mippene shemmasrich et hassear. ella bechammin vaafillu bechamme chamma mippene shehachammin meyashsherin et hassear umesalselin oto. aval hatztzonnin mekalkelin umekabbetzin et hassear umitkashsher:
Nidda shennatna tavshil livnah vetavla lo alta lah tevila mippene hashshamnunit sheal yadeha:

Sarta bivsarah vehotzi dam vetavla. betoch shelosha yamim en mekom hasseritot chotzetz leachar shelosha yamim chotzetz mippene shehaddam nikpe sham kegeled sheal gabbe hammakka. vechen lifluf shebbaayin im haya yavesh vehu shehitchil lehorik chotzetz benidda:
Kochal shebbaayin eno chotzetz. sheal gav haayin chotzetz. veim hayu eneha porchot af al gabbe haayin eno chotzetz:

Patcha eneha beyoter o itztzamtan beyoter lo alta lah tevila. bamme devarim amurim leinyan tohorot. aval lehattirah levaalah hare zo mutteret. af al pi shennatna tavshil livnah o shehaya bah seret yashan o shehaya al gav enah kochal. uven patcha eneha o itztzamtan hare zo mutteret levaalah shekkol haddevarim haellu vechayyotze bahen enan chotztzin ella middivrehen uleinyan tohorot gazru leinyan bia lo gazru. vechol hachotzetz benidda letohorot chotzetz bishar hattemein leinyan tohorot. vechotzetz beger bishat tevila:

Mi shettaval veala venimtza alav davar chotzetz af al pi shennitassek beoto hammin kol hayyom kullo hare hu betumato ad sheyyomar yodea ani bevadday shello haya ze alay kodem hattevila hoil vehuchzak tame haamed tame al tumato ad shetteda bevadday shettahar:
Mishneh Torah, Immersion Pools 3:
Veelu chotztzin bechelim. hazzefet vehachemar vechayyotze bahen. hazzefet shebbakkos veshebbatztzelochit mittochan chotztzin meachorehen enan chotztzin. bamme devarim amurim mibbet haumman. aval mibbaal habbayit ben mittochan ben meachorehen chotztzin. hazzefet shebbattamchuy veshebbakkeara ben mittochan ben meachorehen ben mibbaal habbayit ben mibbet haumman chotztzin: 
Hammor vehakkomos ben bechos ben bitzlochit ben betamchuy ukeara ben mibbaal habbayit ben mibbet haumman ben mittochan ben meachorehen chotztzin. haya zefet o chemar vechayyotze bahen al hattavla veal hashshulchan veal haddargash im hayu nekiyyim chotztzin mippene shemmakpid alehen. veal habbelusin enan chotztzin mippene sheeno makpid alehen: 
Hayu al mittot baal habbayit chotztzin al mittot shel ani enan chotztzin. al ukkaf baal habbayit chotzetz veal zakkakin eno chotzetz. al hammirdaat mishshene tzedadin chotzetz: 
Hayu zefet o chemar vechayyotze bahen al bigde talmide chachamim afillu mitztzad echad chotzetz mippene shemmakpidin al malbushan lihyot naki. al bigde amme haaretz mishshene tzedadin chotzetz mitztzad echad eno chotzetz: 
Hayu al hammitpachot shel zappatim veshel yotzrim veshel mefassele ilanot enan chotztzin: 
Tabbach shehaya dam al begadav eno chotzetz mippene sheeno makpid: 
Mocher revav shehaya revav al bigdo eno chotzetz. vechen kol kayyotze baze. haya hattabbach mocher revav vehaya al bigdo dam urevav hare ze safek im chotzetz mippene shehen shenayim umakpid o eno chotzetz shehare melachto hi veeno makpid: 
Haya hazzefet o hachemar vechayyotze bahen al hassandal mittocho. millemala chotzetz millematta eno chotzetz. al hassafsal millemala o min hatztzedadin chotzetz millematta eno chotzetz: 
Lichluche tzoa shebbakkisse veshebbakkattedra hamechubbashin ben mittochan ben meachorehen ben millematta ben min hatztzedadin enan chotztzin mippene shehammayim maavirin otan. aval lichluche shemarim shebbakkos veshebbatztzelochit vehammoch shebbashsher veshebbazzog. vehattit vehabbatzek sheal yad hakkordom vesheal yad hammagrefa [enan chotztzin. higlidu] chotztzin: 
Davar barur hu shekkol makom sheamarnu bezefet uvechemar vechayyotze bahen sheenan chotztzin bechelim mippene sheeno makpid hu lefichach im haya rov hakkeli chafuy bezefet o bechemar vechayyotze bahen lo alta lo tevila kemo shebbearnu af al pi sheeno makpid. en bedavar ze hefresh bichli min hakkelim ella kol hakkelim shavin bedavar ze: 
Kol yedot hakkelim shehen chalulin shehichnisan shello kedarkan. o shehichnisan kedarkan velo merkan. o shehayu shel mattechet venishberu. lo alta lahen tevila: 
Keli shehafach piv lematta vehitbilo keillu lo taval mippene sheen hammayim nichnasin bechullo. haya bo makom sheen hammayim nichnasin bo ad sheyyattennu al tziddo lo alta lo tevila ad sheyyattennu al tziddo: 
Keli shehu tzar mikkan umikkan verachav baemtza eno tahor ad sheyyattennu al tziddo: 
Tzelochit sheppiha shokea enah tehora ad sheyyattenna al tziddah: 
Kalmarin enah tehora ad sheyyikkavenna mitztziddah kede sheyyikkansu hammayim laakmumiyyut shebbah: 
Behema shehaya hashsher shealeha rafuy venitma matbilin oto bimkomo: 
Lo yatbil adam et hakkumkum befechamin shebbo ella im ken shifshef: 
Keli shehu male mashkin vehitbilo keillu lo taval. haya male mayim vehitbilo hare hammayim vehakkeli tehorin keachat mippene shehammayim yesh lahen tohora bemikve kemo shebbearnu betumat ochalin umashkin. haya hakkeli male me raglayim roin oto keillu hu mayim. haya bo me chattat im haya rov hakkeli panuy kede sheyyirbu me mikve al me chattat shebbetocho hare ze tahor. veim lav adayin hu betumato ucheillu hen shear mashkin shechotztzin ben guf hakkeli uven me hammikve: 
Keli shettocho tahor vegabbo tame vehaya male yayin lavan o chalav vehitbilo. holchin achar harov im haya rov hakkeli panuy kede sheyyirbu hammayim betocho tahor mippene shettumato middivrehen. aval im haya bo yayin adom o shear mashkin lo alta lo tevila: 
Lagin shehu male mayim temein vehaya al piv tit tofeach vehaya hattit shokea bammayim vehitbilo tahor. veim haya tit hayyavin vechayyotze bo keillu lo taval. vechen tabbaat shennetanah bilvena shel tit tofeach vehitbilah tehora. veim haya tit yaven keillu lo tevalah: 
Ellu sheen tzerichin sheyyavou hammayim bahen. setam kishre bigde aniyyim, veim hikpid alehen chotztzin. vekishre bigde baale battim setaman chotztzin, veim eno makpid alehen enan chotztzin. vekishre nime habbegadim shenniksheru mealehen. vechevet hassandal. utefilla shel rosh bizman shehakketzitza devuka im hartzua shebbah vachazaka. utefilla shel zeroa bizman sheenah ola veyoredet. veazne hachemet vehatturemil. vechol kayyotze beellu mikkesharim utefarim sheeno atid lehattiram: 
Veellu shetztzerichin sheyyavou bahen hammayim. hakkesharim shebbefitche hechaluk shehen asuyin lulaot. vechen kishre lulaot shebbakkatef. vesafa shel sadin tzarich lematteach. utefilla shel rosh bizman sheenah kevua birtzua. veshel zeroa bizman shehi ola veyoredet. ushenatzim shel sandal. vekishre nime habbegadim shekkesharan. vechen kol kayyotze beellu hammekomot shehu atid legallotan ulematchan. hassallin shel gat veshel bad im hayu chazakim tzarich lechattet veim hayu rafim tzarich lenaer. hakkar vehakkeset shel or tzerichim sheyyavou bahen hammayim: 
Keset agulla. vehakkaddur. vehaimmum. vehakkamea. vehattefilla. enan tzerichin sheyyavou hammayim lachalalan. ze hakkelal kol sheen darko lehotzi ulehachnis tovel satum: 
Hammatbil begadim hamechubbasin tzerichin sheyyikkansu bahen hammayim ad sheyyevabeu. hitbilan neguvin ad sheyyevabeu veyanuchu mibbiabbuan: 
Kol yedot hakkelim shehen arukkim yoter mikkede tzarkan veatid lekatztzan matbilan ad mekom hammidda. ketzad. shalshelet deli gadol arbaa tefachim vekatan asara. matbil min hashshalshelet ad midda zo bilvad vehashshear tahor: 
Keli tame shennatan betocho kelim acherim vehitbil hakkol alta lahen tevila af al pi sheppi hakkeli tzar beyoter shehare hammayim nichnasin lo umittoch shealta tevila lakkeli haggadol alta tevila lakkelim shebbetocho. veim hittahu al tziddo vehitbil lo alta lahen tevila ad sheyyihye piv rachav kishfoferet hannod. vechen im haya hakkeli tahor venatan letocho kelim temeim vehitbilan lo alta lahen tevila ad sheyyihye piv rachav kishfoferet hannod. bamme devarim amurim litruma. aval lekodesh en matbilin kelim letoch kelim tehorin kelal vaafillu hayu besal o bekuppa kemo shebbearnu lemala bimkomo:
Mishneh Torah, Immersion Pools 4:
Din tora shekkol mayim mechunnasin tovlin bahen shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 36)</small> "mikve mayim" mikkol makom. vehu sheyyihye bahen kede lehaalot bahen kede tevila lechol guf haadam bevat achat. shiaru chachamim amma al amma berum shalosh ammot. veshiur ze hu machazik arbaim sea mayim ben sheuvin ben sheenan sheuvin: 
Middivre sofrim shehammayim hashsheuvin pesulin litvila. velo od ella mikve mayim sheenan sheuvin shennafal letochan shelosha login mayim sheuvin paslu hakkol. af al pi sheppissul mayim sheuvin middivre sofrim lemaduhu behekkesh shehare hu omer <small>(Vayikra 11 36)</small> "ach mayan uvor mikve mayim yihye tahor", hammayan en bo tefisat yad adam kelal vehabbor kullo bide adam shehare kullo mayim sheuvin, amru chachamim hammikve lo yihye kullo shauv kevor veen tzarich lihyot kullo bide shamayim kemayan ella im yesh bo tefisat yad adam kasher: 
Ketzad. hammanniach kankannim berosh haggag lenaggevam veyardu lahem geshamim venitmalleu af al pi shehi onat haggeshamim hare ze yishbor et hakkankannim o yichpem vehammayim hannikvim mehem kesherim litbol veaf al pi shekkol hammayim haellu hayu bakkelim shehare lo millean beyado. lefichach im higbiah et hakkankannim veheeram hare kol hammayim shebbahem sheuvin: 
Hammanniach kelim tachat hatztzinnor tamid bechol et uvechol zeman echad kelim ketannim veechad kelim gedolim afillu kele avanim vechayyotze bahen mikkelim sheenan mekabbelin tuma venitmalleu me geshamim hare ellu pesulin. veim kefaan al pihen o shevaran hammayim hannikvin mehen kishuvin lechol davar shehare ledato nitmalleu shechezkat hatztzinnor lekalleach mayim. vaafillu shachach hakkelim tachat hatztzinnor pesulin gazru al hashshocheach mippene hammanniach. vechen hammanniach et hakkelim bechatzer beet kishshur heavim venitmalleu hammayim shebbahen pesulin shehare ledato nitmalleu. vechen gazru al hashshocheach bechatzer bishat kishshur avim mishshum manniach. hinnichan bechatzer beet pizzur avim uvau avim venitmalleu hare ellu kesherin kemo shemmannichan berosh haggag lenaggevan. vechen im hinnichan beet kishshur heavim venitpazzeru vechazru venitkashsheru venitmalleu hare ellu kesherin. veim shibberan o kefaan hammayim hannikvin mehen kesherin: 
Hassayyad sheshshachach atzitz bammikve venitmalleu mayim af al pi shello nishar bammikve ella meat vahare heatzitz yesh bo rov hammikve hare ze yishbor et heatzitz bimkomo venimtza hammikve kullo kasher. vechen hamesadder et hakkankannim betoch hammikve kede lechasseman venitmalleu mayim af al pi shebbala hammikve et memav velo nishar sham mayim kelal ella mayim shebbetoch hakkankannim hare ze yishbor et hakkankannim vehammayim hannikvin mehen mikve kasher: 
Ketzad poslin hammayim hashsheuvin et hammikve bishlosha login. sheim haya bammikve pachot mearbaim sea [venafal letochan shelosha login vehishlimum learbaim sea] hakkol pasul. aval mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea mayim sheenan sheuvin veshaav bechad veshafach letocho kol hayyom kullo kasher. velo od ella mikve elyon sheyyesh bo arbaim sea mayim kesherin vehaya memalle bichli venoten letocho ad sheyyirbu hammayim veyardu lammikve hattachton arbaim sea hare hattachton kasher: 
Mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea mechuvvanot venatan letocho sea mayim sheuvin venatal achar kach mimmennu sea hare ze kasher. vechen noten sea venotel sea vehu kasher ad rubbo: 
En hammayim hashsheuvin poslin et hammikve bishlosha login ad sheyyippelu letoch hammikve min hakkeli. aval im nigreru hammayim hashsheuvin chutz lammikve venimshechu veyardu lammikve enan poslin et hammikve ad sheyyihyu mechetza lemechetza aval im haya rov min hakkesherim hare hammikve kasher. ketzad. mikve sheyyesh bo esrim sea umashshehu mayim kesherin vehaya memalle veshoev chutz lammikve vehammayim nimshachin veyordin lammikve ben shehayu nimshachin al hakkarka o betoch hassilon vechayyotze bo middevarim sheenan poslin et hammikve hare hu kasher vaafillu hishlimo leelef sea. shehashsheiva shehimshichuha keshera im haya sham rov arbaim sea min hakkasher. vechen gag shehaya berosho esrim sea umashshehu me geshamim umille bichtefo venatan letocho pachot meesrim shennimtza hakkol pasul ufatach hatztzinnor venimshechu hakkol lemakom echad hare ze mikve kasher. shehashsheuvim shehimshichuha kullah keshera hoil vehaya sham rov min hakkasher: 
Horu miktzat chachme maarav veamru hoil veamru chachamim sheuva shehimshichuha kullah tehora en anu tzerichin sheyyihyu sham rov mayim kesherin. veze shehitzrich rov vehameshacha divre yachid hen uchevar niddechu shehare amru bassof sheuva shehimshichuha kullah tehora. lefi divre ze im haya memalle bichli veshofech vehammayim nizchalin veholchin lemakom echad hare ze mikve kasher. vechen kol ambeti shebbemerchatzaot shellanu mikvaot kesherin. shehare kol hammayim shebbahen shauv veshennimshach hu. umeolam lo rainu mi sheasa maase beinyan ze: 
Me geshamim umayim sheuvin shehayu mitarvin bechatzer venimshachin veyordin laukka shebbechatzer o shemmitarvin al maalot hammeara veyordin lammeara. im rov min hakkasher kasher veim rov min happasul pasul. mechetza lemechetza pasul. ematay bizman shemmitarvin ad shello yaggiu lammikve venimshachin veyordin aval im hayu hakkesherim vehappesulim mekallechin letoch hammikve im yadua shennaflu letocho arbaim sea mayim kesherin ad shello yardu letocho shelosha login mayim sheuvin kasher veim lav pasul:
Mishneh Torah, Immersion Pools 5: Mikve shennaflu elav shelosha login mayim sheuvin mikkeli echad o mishshenayim ushelosha kelim mitztarfin vehu sheyyatchil hashsheni ad shello pasak harishon. mearbaa kelim en mitztarfin. bamme devarim amurim bizman shello nitkavven lerabbot. aval im nitkavven lerabbot et me hammikve afillu nafal mishkal dinar bechol shana mitztaref lishlosha login ben shekkadmu hashsheuvim et hakkesherim ben shekkadmu hakkesherim et hashsheuvim o shennaflu shetehen keachat. kevan shennaflu shelosha login sheuvin letoch arbaim sea [kodem shennaflu bo arbaim sea o lefachot mearbaim] nifsal hakkol venaasa shauv:

Shenayim shehetilu ze log umechetza veze log umechetza. vehassochet kesuto vehigbihah vehammayim shebbah noflin mimmekomot harebe. vechen hameare min hatztzartzur shemmetil mimmekomot harebe hare ellu poslin:

Hammatbil kar o keset shel or bemikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea mechuvvanot kevan shehigbiah siftotehen min hammayim nimtzeu hammayim shebbetochan sheuvin. ketzad yaase. matbilan umaalan derech shulehen. aval hakkuppa vehassak matbilan umaalan kedarkan veeno choshesh:

Kol hammikvaot hannimtzaim beeretz haammim pesulin shechezkatan sheuvin. vechol hammikvaot hannimtzaim beeretz yisrael bammedinot lefanim min hammafteach bechezkat pesulin sheanshe hammedina mechabbesim bahen umetilin letochan mayim sheuvim tamid. vechol hammikvaot hannimtzeim beeretz yisrael chutz lammafteach bechezkat tohora shechezkatan min haggeshamim: 
Hattame sheyyarad litbol safek taval safek lo taval vaafillu taval safek yesh bo arbaim sea safek en bo. shene mikvaot echad yesh bo arbaim sea veechad en bo vetaval beechad mehen veen yadua beeze mehen taval sefeko tame lefi shehattame bechezkato ad sheyyivvada shettaval karauy. vechen mikve shennimdad venimtza chaser ben shehaya hammikve birshut harabbim ben shehaya birshut hayyachid kol hattohorot shennaasu al gabbav lemafrea temeot ad sheyyivvada zeman shennimdad bo vehaya shalem. bamme devarim amurim keshehayta hattevila mittuma chamura. aval im taval mittuma kalla kegon sheachal ochalin temein o shata mashkin temein o ba rosho verubbo bemayim sheuvin o shennaflu al rosho veal rubbo sheloshet login mayim sheuvin. hoil veikkar devarim ellu middivrehen hare sefeko tahor kemo shebbearnu. veaf al pi shennistappek lo im taval o lo taval o shennimtza hammikve chaser leachar zeman vechayyotze bisfekot ellu hare ze tahor: 
Shene mikvaot echad kasher veechad pasul vetaval beechad mehen mittuma chamura veasa tohorot hare ellu teluyot. taval bashsheni veasa tohorot harishonot teluyot keshehayu vehashsheniyyot tehorot. veim nagu ellu beellu rishonot teluyot usheniyyot yissarfu. vechen im nitma baemtza tuma kalla shebbearnu vetaval bashsheni veasa tohorot. aval im taval beechad mehen mittuma kalla veasa tohorot venitma tuma chamura vetaval bashsheni veasa tohorot harishonot tehorot vehashsheniyyot teluyot. veim nagu ellu beellu rishonot yissarfu vehashsheniyyot teluyot keshehayu. haya beechad mehen arbaim sea veechad kullo shauv vetavlu bahen shenayim echad mittuma chamura veechad mittuma kalla veasu tohorot hattovel mittuma chamura tohorotav teluyot vehattovel mittuma kalla tohorotav tehorot. haya echad tame veyarad litbol vehashsheni yered lehaker ze sheyyarad litbol beechad mehen tohorotav teluyot kemo shebbearnu. veze sheyyarad lehaker tahor keshehaya. shezze sefek mayim sheuvin hu shemma bashshauv taval kesheheker venitma: 
Shene mikvaot shel esrim esrim sea echad shauv veechad kasher. heker beechad mehen veasa tohorot hare ellu tehorot. heker bashsheni veasa tohorot hare ellu yissarfu. shehare vadday ba rosho verubbo bemayim sheuvin kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Immersion Pools 11:
Kevar bearnu shennetilat yadayim utevilatan middivre sofrim. veyadayim shetztzerichot tevila en matbilin otan ella bemikve kasher sheyyesh bo arbaim sea. shebbemakom shehaadam tovel bo kelim yadayim tovlin. aval yadayim sheen tzerichot ella netila bilvad im hitbilan beme mikve tehorin. veim hitbilan bemayim sheuvin ben bechelim ben bekarkaot lo taharu yadav ad sheyyippelu hammayim hashsheuvim min hakkeli al yadav. sheen notlin layyadayim ella min hakkelim umikkoach noten kemo shebbearnu behilchot berachot: 
Kol hachotzetz bitvila chotzetz bayyadayim ben bitvilatan ben bintilatan. vechol haole lemiddat hammikve ketit hannerok ole leshiur harviit shennotlin bahen hayyadayim. vechol hannotel yadav tzarich leshafshef: 
Hannotel shete yadav litruma tzarich lachzor velittol paam sheniyya bemayim sheniyyim kede lehasir hammayim sheal gav yadav shehare hammayim shennatal bahen techilla vehen hannikrain mayim rishonim nitmeu beyadav. lefichach im nafal kikkar shel teruma letoch hammayim shennatal bahen yadav techilla nitma veim nafal letoch hammayim hashsheniyyim lo nitma. veim natal rishonim usheniyyim lemakom echad venafal sham kikkar shel teruma nitma. natal et harishonim venimtza al yadav davar chotzetz vehesiro venatal et hashsheniyyim hare yadav temeot keshehayu sheen hammayim hashsheniyyim metaharin ella hannishar min hammayim harishonim al gabbe yadav: 
Hayyadayim mittammeot umittaharot ad happerek. ketzad. natal et harishonim ad happerek venatal hammayim hashsheniyyim chutz lapperek vechazru michutz lapperek leyadav hare yadav tehorot shehammayim hashsheniyyim tehorin hen. natal et harishonim vehashsheniyyim chutz lapperek vechazru leyado nitmet yado shehammayim harishonim shechutz lapperek nitmeu mechamat yadav veen hammayim hashsheniyyim metaharim bammayim shechutz lapperek. ulefi shechazru hammayim shechutz lapperek leyado timmeuha: 
Natal et harishonim leyado achat venimlach venatal et hashsheniyyim lishte yadav temeot shehashsheniyyim mittammein mechamat hayyad shello nittela bemayim rishonim vechozrin umetammein et hayyad hashsheniyya. natal et harishonim lishte yadav venatal et hashsheniyyim leyado achat haachat tehora. natal yado achat veshifshefah bachavertah nitmeu hammayim shealeha mechamat chavertah shello nittela vechozrin umetammein et hayyad shennittela. shifshefah berosho o bakkotel hare zo tehora: 
Natal shete yadav mishshetifa achat hare ellu tehorin veen omrin hare ze kenotel yado achat bammayim sheyyardu meal yado hashsheniyya. afillu arbaa o chamishsha ze betzad ze o ze al gav ze. uvilvad sheyyarpu sheyyavou bahen hammayim: 
Natal miktzat yado vechazar vehosif venatal hannishar min yado hare yado temea keshehayta. veim adayin yesh al miktzat shennatal battechilla tofeach al menat lehatepiach hare zo tehora. bamme devarim amurim bemayim rishonim. aval bishniyyim notel miktzat yadav vechozer umosif al miktzatan: 
Shiur hammayim shennotlin bahen techilla reviit lechol adam veadam lishte hayadayim en pachot mishshiur ze kemo shebbearnu bintilat yadayim lefat. aval mayim sheniyyim yesh lishnayim littol yedehen merviit. umechatzi log notnin lishlosha ulearbaa. umillog notnin afillu lemea sheen hammayim hashsheniyyim letaher ella lehaavir hammayim harishonim: 
Keli shehaya bo reviit mayim kesherim lintilat yadayim venatan letocho meat mayim pesulin lintilat yadayim hare ellu kesherin. natal min hakkeli kashshiur shennatan venishara reviit bilvad keshehayta hare zo pesula mippene shehammayim happesulin hishlimu shiur harviit: 
Kol hammayim happesulin lintila bemayim rishonim kach hen pesulin bemayim sheniyyim. vechol keli sheen notlin mimmennu bemayim rishonim kach en notlin mimmennu mayim sheniyyim. ucheshem shetztzarich lihyot hammayim harishonim mikkoach adam kach hammayim hashsheniyyim: 
Kevar bearnu beferek shishshi mehilchot berachot kol mine hammayim happesulin lintilat yadayim vehechsheran. vechol hakkelim shennotlin bahen layyadayim vesheen notlin. vee zo netina hi mikkoach noten ucheshera vee zo netina enah mikkoach noten ufesula. vechol otan haddevarim shebbearnu sham bintilat yadayim lefat chullin kach hen litruma. ucheshem shekkol sefek yadayim tehorot lechullin kemo shebbearnu sham. kach hen litruma kol sefek yadayim tahor: 
Davar barur vegaluy shehattumot vehattohorot gezerot hakkatuv hen. veenan middevarim sheddato shel adam machraato. vahare hen mikkelal hachukkim. vechen hattevila min hattumot mikkelal hachukkim hu sheen hattuma tit o tzoa shettaavor bemayim ella gezerat hakkatuv hi vehaddavar taluy bechavvanat hallev. ulefichach amru chachamim taval velo huchzak keillu lo taval. veaf al pi chen remez yesh baddavar keshem shehamechavven libbo letaher kevan shettaval tahor veaf al pi shello nitchaddesh begufo davar kach hamechavven libbo letaher nafsho mittumot hannefashot shehen machshevot haaven vedeot haraot. kevan shehiskim belibbo lifrosh meotan haetzot vehevi nafsho beme haddaat tahor. hare hu omer <small>(Yechezkel 36 25)</small> "vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim utehartem mikkol tumotechem umikkol gillulechem ataher etchem". hashshem berachamav harabbim mikkol chet avon veashma yetaharenu amen:
Mishneh Torah, Inheritances 1: Seder nechalot kach hi. mi shemmet yirashuhu banav vehem kodmin lakkol. vehazzecharim kodmin linkevot:
Bechol makom en linkeva im hazzachar yerushsha. im en lo banim yirashennu aviv. veen haem yoreshet et baneha vedavar ze mippi hakkabbala:

Vechol hakkodem benachala yotze yerecho kodmin. lefichach mi shemmet ben ish ben ishsha im hinniach ben yoresh hakkol. lo nimtza lo ben leolam meayyenin bezaro shel ben im nimtza livno zera ben zecharim ben nekevot afillu bat bat bat beno ad sof haolam hi tirash et hakkol. lo nimtza lo zera ben chozrin etzel habbat. hayta lo bat tirash et hakkol lo nimtzet lo bat baolam meayyenin al zera habbat. im nimtza lah zera ben zecharim ben nekevot ad sof haolam hu yoresh hakkol. lo nimtza lah zera bat chozer hayerushsha leaviv. lo haya aviv kayyam meayyenin al zera haav shehen ache hammet. nimtza lo ach o zera ach yoresh et hakkol veim lav chozrin etzel achot. nimtzet lo achot o zarah yoresh hakkol. veim lo nimtzet lo zera achim velo zera achot hoil veen laav zera tachzor hayerushsha laavi  haav. lo haya avi haav kayyam meayyenin al zera shel avi haav shehen ache aviv shel met vehazzecharim kodmin linkevot vezaran shel zecharim kodmin linkevot kemo shehaya haddin bezaro shel met atzmo. lo nimtzeu achim leaviv lo hem velo zaran tachzor hayerushsha laavi avi haav. veal hadderech hazzot nachala memashmeshet veholechet ad reuven. nimtzeta omer habben kodem labbat vechol yotze yerecho shel ben kodmin labbat vehabbat kodemet laavi aviha vechol yotze yerechah kodmin laavi aviha. vaavi hammet kodem laache hammet mippene shehem yotze yerecho vehaach kodem laachot. vechol yotze yerecho shel ach kodmin laachot. veachot kodemet laavi aviha. vechol yotze yerechah kodmin laavi aviha. avi haav kodem laache haav shel met vaache aviv kodmin laachot aviv vechol yotze yerecho shel ache aviv kodmin laachot aviv vaachot aviv kodemet laavi avi aviv shel met. vechen kol yotze yerechah shel achot aviv kodmin laavi avi aviv. veal derech zo holech veole ad rosh haddorot. lefichach en lecha adam miyyisrael sheen lo yorshin:

Mi shemmet vehinniach bat uvat habben vaafillu bat bat bat habben ad sof kamma dorot hi kodemet vetirash hakkol veen labbat kelum. vehu haddin levat haach im haachot ulevat ben achi aviv im achot aviv. vechen kol kayyotze bahen:

Mi shehayu lo shene banim umetu hashshene banim bechayyav vehinniach habben haechad shelosha banim vehinniach habben hashsheni bat achat veachar kach met hazzaken nimtzeu sheloshet bene banav yorshin chatzi hannachala uvat beno yoreshet hachetzi shekkol echad veechad mehen yoresh chelek aviv. veal derech zo cholkin bene haachim uvene ache haav ad rosh haddorot:

Mishpachat haem enah keruya mishpacha veen yerushsha ella lemishpachat haav. lefichach haachim min haem en yorshin ze et ze veachin min haav yorshin ze et ze. veechad achiv shehu meaviv bilvad o achiv meaviv umeimmo:

Kol hakkerovin baavera yorshin kichsherim. ketzad. kegon shehaya lo ben mamzer o ach mamzer hare ellu kishar banim vechishar achim lannachala. aval beno min hashshifcha o min hannachrit eno ben ledavar min haddevarim veeno yoresh kelal:

Haishsha enah yoreshet balah kelal. vehabbaal yoresh et kol nichse ishto middivre sofrim. vehu kodem lakkol birushshatah af al pi shehi asura alav. kegon almana lechohen gadol gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot. veaf al pi shehi ketanna veaf al pi shehabbaal cheresh hu yoresh et ishto:

Kevar bearnu behilchot ishut sheen habbaal yoresh et ishto ad shettikkanes birshuto vesheen happikkeach yoresh et hachereshet shennisset keshehi chereshet afillu nitpakkecha. vesham bearnu shehu yoresh et nichse ishto shebbau lirushshatah vehuchzeku ben nechasim shehichnisa lo bindunyatah ben nechasim shello hichnisa lo. umi shennitgarsha sefek gerushin umeta en habbaal yorshah:
Baal shennasa ketanna sheenah tzericha meun eno yorshah shehare en kan shum ishut. vechen shote shennasa pikkachat o pikkeach shennasa shota eno yorshah shehare lo tikkenu chachamim lahen nissuin:

Baal shemmeta ishto veachar kach met aviha o achiha o echad min hammorishin otah en habbaal yoresh otan. ella yoresh otan zarah im haya lah zera o tachzor hayerushsha lemishpachat bet aviha. sheen habbaal yoresh nechasim haruyin lavo leachar mikkan ella lannechasim shekkevar bau lirushsha kodem shettamut:

Vechen en habbaal yoresh et ishto vehu bakkever kishar hayyorshin shel mishpachat haav. ketzad. baal shemmet veachar kach meta ishto en omrin hoil vehabbaal haya kodem lechol adam birushshatah kach yorshe habbaal yikdemu lishar yorshe haishsha ella yorshe haishsha mimmishpachat bet aviha hem hayyorshim otah im meta achar balah:

Vechen en habben yoresh et immo bakkever kede lehanechil leechav meaviv. ketzad. mi shemmet veachar kach meta immo en omrin hoil veillu haya habben kayyam haya kodem af yorshin shel ben kodmin leyorsheha shel ishsha zo venimtzeu echav meaviv yorshin et immo shel ze achar moto shel ze. ella zera benah hu sheyyirashenna im haya lo zera veim en lo zera tachzor yerushshatah lemishpachat bet aviha. aval im meta haem techilla veachar kach met habben afillu haya katan ben yomo velo kalu lo chodashav hoil vechaya achar immo shaa achat umet hare ze nochel et immo umanchil hannachala leyorshav mimmishpachat aviv:
Mishneh Torah, Inheritances 2:
Habbechor notel pi shenayim benichse aviv shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 17)</small> "latet lo pi shenayim". ketzad. hinniach chamishsha banim veechad mehen bechor habbechor notel shelish hammamon vechol echad mehaarbaa peshutim notel shetut. hinniach tisha banim hare (haechad) habbechor notel chamishit vechol echad min hashshemona peshutim notel asirit vechen al hachaluka hazzot cholkin leolam: 
Bechor shennolad achar mitat aviv eno notel pi shenayim. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 16)</small> "vehaya beyom hanechilo et banav" vegomer <small>(Devarim 21 17)</small> "ki et habbechor ben hassenua yakkir". veim yatzat paddachto bechayye aviv af al pi shello yatza kol rosho laavir haolam ella leachar mitat aviv hare ze notel pi shenayim: 
Bechor shennikra venimtza zachar eno notel pi shenayim ufashut shennikra venimtza zachar eno memaet bechelek bechorah shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 15)</small> "veyaldu lo vanim" ad sheyyihye ben mishsheat leda: 
Ketzad eno memaet bechelek bechora. hare shehaya lo ben bechor ushene peshutim veze hattumtum shennikra venimtza zachar. habbechor notel revia hammamon bechelek habbechora ucheillu en immo ella shene happeshutim bilvad. vachatzi urevia hannishar cholkin oto shene happeshutin im hannikra veim habbechor beshave: 
Katan ben yom echad memaet bechelek bechora aval lo haubbar. uven shennolad achar mitat aviv eno memaet bechelek bechora: 
Ben shennistappek lanu im hu bechor o pashut kegon shennitarev im acher eno notel pi shenayim. vechetzad osin. im hukkeru ulevassof nitarvu kotvin hareshaa ze laze venotlin chelek bechora im achehem. veim lo hukkeru kegon sheyyelado bemachavoa achat en kotvin hareshaa veen kan chelek bechora: 
Mi shehayu lo shene banim bechor ufashut umetu shenehem bechayyav vehinnichu banim. habbechor heniach bat vehappashut hinniach ben. hare ben happashut yoresh benichse hazzaken shelish shehu chelek aviv. uvat habbechor yoreshet shene shelishim shehu chelek aviha. vechen haddin bivne haachin uvene ache haav uvechol hayyorshin im haya avi echad min hayyorshim bechor notel chelek bechora shello ze hayyoresh mechamato: 
En habbechor notel pi shenayim benichse haem. ketzad. bechor ufashut sheyyarshu imman cholkin beshave ben shehaya bechor lenachala ben shehaya peter rechem: 
Bechor lenachala hu hannolad laav rishon shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 17)</small> "ki hu reshit ono". veen mashgichin al haem afillu yalda kamma banim hoil veze rishon leaviv yoresh pi shenayim: 
Habba achar nefalim af al pi sheyyatza rosh hannefel keshehu chay habba acharav bechor lenachala. vechen ben tisha sheyyatza rosho met habba acharav bechor lenachala shezze shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 17)</small> "reshit ono" hu shello nolad lo kodem laze valad sheyyatza chay laavir haolam. lefichach ben tisha shehotzi rov rosho chay habba acharav eno bechor: 
Yotze dofen vehabba acharav shenehen enan bechorim. harishon lefi shello nolad veneemar <small>(Devarim 21 15)</small> "veyaldu lo vanim". vehashsheni shehare kedamo acher: 
Hayu lo banim keshehaya akkum venitgayyer en lo bechor lenachala. aval yisrael shehaya lo ben min hashshifcha umin haakkum hoil veeno karuy beno habba lo acharav min hayyisreelit bechor lenachala venotel pi shenayim: 
Haya habbechor mamzer notel pi shenayim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 17)</small> "ki et habbechor ben hassenua yakkir" zo shessenua benissueha. veen tzarich lomar im haya ben gerusha o ben chalutza: 
Shelosha neemanin al habbechor. chayya veimmo veaviv. chayya miyyad sheim amra ze yatza rishon neemenet. immo kol shivat yeme halleda neemenet lomar zehu habbechor. aviv leolam afillu amar haav al mi shello huchzak beno kelal hu beni uvechori hu neeman. vechen im amar al hammuchzak lanu shehu bechoro eno bechor neeman: 
Haav shennishtattek bodkin oto kederech shebbodkin legittin. im ramaz o katav shezze beno bechoro hare ze notel pi shenayim: 
Heidu edim shehen shamu aviv shel ze omer devarim kach vechach shehare otan haddevarim yodea mikkelalan shezze beno bechoro. hare ze notel pi shenayim af al pi shello amar haav beferush ze beni bechori: 
Shamu min haav sheamar ze beni bechor eno notel pi shenayim beedut zo shemma bechor leimmo hu velaze nitkavven haav ad sheyyomar beni bechori:
Mishneh Torah, Inheritances 3:
En habbechor notel pi shenayim binchasim haruyin lavo leachar mitat aviv ella binchasim hammuchzakin leaviv shebbau lirshuto shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 17)</small> "bechl asher yimmatze lo". ketzad. echad mimmorishe aviv shemmet leachar mitat aviv habbechor vehappashut yorshin keechad. vechen im hayta leaviv milve o hayta lo sefina bayyam yorshin keechad: 
Hinniach lahem para muskeret o muchkeret o shehayta roa baafar veyalda. habbechor notel bah uvivladah pi shenayim: 
Shachat echad mimmakkire aviv behema veachar kach met aviv notel pi shenayim bammattanot shel otah behema: 
En habbechor notel pi shenayim bashshevach sheshshavchu nechasim leachar mitat aviv ella maale oto hashshevach bedamim venoten hayyeter lappashut. vehu sheyyishtannu hannechasim kegon karmel shennaasu shibbolim vechifniyyot shennaasu temarim. aval shavchu mechamat atzman velo nishtannu kegon ilan katan sheggadal veava veeretz sheheelta sirton hare ze notel bashshevach pi shenayim. veim mechamat hotzaa hishbiach eno notel: 
En habbechor notel pi shenayim bemilve af al pi shehu bishtar af al gav sheggavu karka bechov avihem. haya leav milve beyad habbechor hare ze safek im notel bah pi shenayim hoil veyeshnah tachat yado. o lo yittol hoil umechamat aviv yirashenna vaadayin lo baa leyado shel aviv. lefichach yittol mimmenna chatzi chelek bechora: 
Bechor shemmachar chelek bechora kodem chaluka mimkaro kayyam mippene sheyyesh labbechor chelek bechora kodem chaluka. lefichach im chalak im echav kodem bemiktzat nechasim ben bakkarka ben bemittaltelin venatal chelek kefashut vitter bechol hannechasim veeno notel bisheran ella kefashut. bamme devarim amurim beshello micha. aval im micha beechav veamar bifne shenayim anavim ellu sheani cholek im echay beshave lo mippene shemmachalti bechelek bechora hare ze mechaa velo vitter bishar nechasim. vaafillu micha baanavim keshehen mechubbarim uvetzarum vechillekum beshave lo vitter bishar nechasim. aval im derachum vechalak immahen beshave beyayin velo micha bahen mishshennaasa yayin vitter bishar hannechasim. ha lema ze dome lemi shemmicha baanavim vechalak immahem beshave bazetim shehare vitter bakkol. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Mi sheyyibbem eshet achiv hu yoresh kol nichse echav hammuchzakim. vechol haruyin lavo leachar mikkan hare hu bahen kechol haachim shehare bechor kara oto hakkatuv shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 6)</small> "vehaya habbechor asher teled yakum al shem achiv hammet velo yimmache shemo miyyisrael". ucheshem sheeno notel mimmennu berauy kivmuchzak kach eno notel bashshevach sheshshavchu nechasim achare mot aviv mishsheat mita ad sheat chalukato im echav benichse aviv. vaafillu hishbichu nechasim achar sheyyibbem vekodem sheyyachleku hare hu bashshevach keechad min haachin. af al pi shennotel min hannechasim ellu shene chalakim chelko vechelek achiv sheyyibbem ishto hoil umet haav bechayye kullan: 
Kevar bearnu behilchot shechenim shehabbechor notel shene chalakim shello keechad bemetzar echad. aval hayyavam shechalak im echav benichse aviv notel chelko vechelek achiv begoral. veim ala goralo bishne mekomot notel bishne mekomot: 
Shomeret yavam shemmeta afillu asa bah echad min haachim maamar mishpachat bet aviha yorshin benichse melog vachatzi nichse tzon barzel. veyorshe habbaal yorshin ketubbatah im chatzi nichse tzon barzel. veyorshe habbaal chayyavin bikvuratah hoil vehen yirshu ketubbatah kemo shebbearnu bimkomo:
Mishneh Torah, Inheritances 4:
Haomer ze beni o ze achi o ze achi avi o shear hayyorshin oto. af al pi shehoda baanashim sheenan muchzakin shehen kerovav hare ze neeman veyirashennu ben sheamar keshehu bari ben sheamar keshehu shechiv mera. afillu nishtattek vechatav bichtav yado shezze yorsho bodkin oto kederech shebbodkin legittin: 
Hayinu muchzakin baze shehu achiv o ben dodo veamar eno achi veeno ben dodi eno neeman. aval neeman hu al mi shehuchzak shehu beno lomar eno beni velo yirashennu. veyerae li sheafillu hayu labben banim af al pi sheeno neeman alav lomar eno beni leinyan yichus veen machazikin oto mamzer al piv. neeman hu leinyan yerushsha velo yirashennu: 
Haomer ze beni vechazar veamar avdi hu eno neeman. amar avdi vechazar veamar beni af al pi shehu meshammesho keeved neeman shezze sheamar avdi kelomar shehu li keeved. veim hayu korin lo eved ben mea zuz vechayyotze bidvarim ellu sheen omrin otan beyichud ella laavadim hare ze eno neeman:
