Haya over al bet hammeches veamar beni hu ze vechazar achar kach veamar avdi neeman. shello amar beni ella lehaveriach min hammeches. amar bevet hammoches avdi hu vechazar veamar beni hu eno neeman: 
Haavadim vehashshefachot en korin lahen abba peloni veimma pelonit shello yavo min haddavar takkala venimtza ze habben nifgam. lefichach im hayu haavadim vehashshefachot chashuvin beyoter veyesh lahen kol vechol hakkahal makkirin otan veet bene veavde adonehem kegon avde hannasi hare ellu muttar likrot lahen abba veimma: 
Mi shehayta lo shifcha veholid mimmenna ben vehaya noheg bo minhag banim. o sheamar beni hu umeshuchreret hi immo. im talmid chacham hu o adam kasher shehu baduk bedikduke mitzvot hare ze yirashennu. veaf al pi chen eno nose bat yisrael ad sheyyavi reaya shennishtachrera immo veachar kach yalda shehare huchzeka shifcha befanenu. veim mishshear hedyotot hu veen tzarich lomar im haya min hammafkirin atzman lechach hare ze bechezkat eved lechol davar veechav meaviv mochrin oto. veim en leaviv ben chutz mimmennu eshet aviv mityabbemet. veze hu haddin sheyyerae li shehu holech al ikkere hakkabbala. veyesh mi shello chillek ben kesherim lishar haam ella leinyan shello yimkeruhu echav bilvad. veyesh mi shehora sheafillu leyarsho lo nachlok beyisrael veen rauy lismoch al davar ze: 
Kol hayyorshin yorshin bachazaka. ketzad. edim sheheidu shezze muchzak lanu shehu beno shel peloni o achiv. af al pi sheenan ede yichus velo yadu amittat hayyuchasin hare ellu yorshin beedut zo: 
Yaakov shemmet vehinniach reuven veshimon velo huchzak lo ben ella shenehem. tafas reuven levi min hashshuk veamar gam ze achinu hu veshimon omer eni yodea. hare shimon notel chatzi hammamon ureuven shelish shehare hoda shehem shelosha achin velevi notel shetut. met levi yachzor hashshetut liruven. naflu lelevi nechasim acherim yachleku otan reuven veshimon shehare reuven mode leshimon shellevi ze achihen. hishbiach hashshetut meelav veachar kach met levi. im shevach maggia lakketefayim hu kegon anavim shehiggiu lehibbatzer. hare hashshevach hazze kinchasim shennaflu lo meacherim veyachleku bahen. veim adayin lo higgiu lehibbatzer hare hen shel reuven levaddo. amar shimon en levi ze achi venatal levi bechelek reuven kemo shebbearnu veachar kach met levi lo yirash shimon mimmennu kelum ella reuven levaddo yirash hashshetut im shear nechasim acherim shehinniach levi. vehu haddin bechol hayyorshin sheyyodu miktzatan beyorshin acherim shello yodu miktzatan:
Mishneh Torah, Inheritances 5:
Ze hakkelal beyorshin. kol shene yorshin sheechad mehen yoresh vadday vehashsheni safek en lassafek kelum. veim hayu shenehem safek shemma zehu hayyoresh o shemma ze hayyoresh cholkin beshave. lefichach mi shemmet vehinniach ben vetumtum o anderoginus hare habben yoresh et hakkol shehattumtum vehaanderoginus safek. hinniach banot vetumtum veanderoginus yorshot beshave vahare hu keachat min habbanot: 
Kevar bearnu behilchot ishut din habbanot im habbanim bimzonotehen uvefarnasatan vesham bearnu shehammezonot mittenae ketubba. bizman shehannechasim merubbin en labbanot ella mezonotehen vehabbanim yirshu hakkol veyitparnesu habbanot beissur nechasim kede sheyyinnasu bo levalehen. uvizman shehannechasim muatin en labbanim kelum ella hakkol limzon habbanot. lefichach mi shemmet vehinniach banim uvanot vetumtum o anderoginus. bizman shehannechasim merubbin habbanim yorshin vedochin hattumtum etzel habbanot venizzon kemotan. uvizman shehannechasin muatin habbanot dochot et hattumtum etzel habbanim veomrot lo zachar atta veen lecha immanu mezonot: 
Mi shello shahata achar balah shelosha chodashim venisset veyalda ben veen yadua im ben tisha lerishon o ben shiva leacharon en ze habben yoresh et echad mishshenehem mippene shehu safek. veim met habben shenehen yorshin oto vecholkin beshave mippene sheshshenehem safek shemma ze aviv o ze aviv: 
Yevama shello shahata shelosha chodashim venityabbema betoch shelosha chodashim veyalda ben veen yadua im ben tisha larishon o ben shiva laacharon. ze hassafek omer shemma ben hammet ani veirash et nichse avi kullan veen atta rauy leyabbem otah sheen immi bat yibbum vehayyavam omer shemma beni atta veimmecha reuya leyabbem veen lecha benichse achi kelum. hoil vegam ze hayyavam safek shemma yavam hu o eno yavam cholkin beshave. vechen din ze hassafek im bene hayyavam benichse hammet shennityabbema ishto cholkin beshave hassafek notel mechetza uvene hayyavam mechetza. met hayyavam achar shechalak im ze hassafek uvau bene hayyavam haruyim lirash avihem af al pi sheyyesh leze hassafek lomar im achichem ani tenu li chelek birushsha zo veim eni achichem hacheziru li hachetzi shellakach avichem en leze hassafek benichse avihen immahen kelum veen motzi miyyadan: 
Safek vehayyavam shebbau lachlok benichse haav hare hayyavam yoresh vadday veze hassafek im hu ben hammet yesh lo chatzi hammamon uleze hayyavam chatzi. veim hu ben hayyavam en lo kelum. lefichach hayyavam yoresh veyiddache hassafek. hinniach hayyavam shene banim vaddain veachar kach met hayyavam hare hassafek omer ani ben hammet veyesh li mechetza velishnechem mechetza vehashshenayim omrim atta achinu uven hayyavam atta veen lecha ella shelish benichse hazzaken hachetzi shemmode lahem bo notlin vehishlish shemmodin hen lo notel vehashshetut hannishar cholkim oto beshave hu notel chetzyo ushenehem chetzyo. met hassafek hare hayyavam omer shemma beni hu vaani irashennu vaavi hayyavam omer shemma ben beni hammet hu vaani irashennu cholkin beshave (met hayyavam hassafek omer beno ani veirashennu vaavi hayyavam omer shemma ben beni haacher atta veze achi avicha hu vaani irashennu cholkin beshave): 
Mi shennafal habbayit alav veal ishto veen yadua im haishsha meta techilla venimtzeu yorshe habbaal yorshin kol nechaseha o habbaal met techilla venimtzeu yorshe haishsha yorshin kol nechaseha ketzad dinam. maamidin nichse melog bechezkat yorshe haishsha vehakketubba ikkar vehattosefet bechezkat yorshe habbaal vecholkin benichse tzon barzel yorshe haishsha notlin chetzyan veyorshe habbaal chetzyan. aval im nafal habbayit alav veal immo maamidin nichse haem bechezkat yorshe haem shehem yorshin vaddain aval yorshe habben safek hem sheim met habben techilla en leechav meaviv benichse imman kelum kemo shebbearnu: 
Nafal habbayit alav veal ben bitto im haav met techilla ben bitto yirashennu venimtzeu hannechasim shel yorshe habben. veim ben bitto met techilla en habben yoresh et immo bakkever kemo shebbearnu venimtzeu hannechasim shel yorshe haav. lefichach yachleku yorshe haav im yorshe ben habbat. vechen im [nishba] haav umet ben bitto bammedina o shennishba habben umet avi immo bammedina yachleku yorshe haav im yorshe ben habbat: 
Nafal alav habbayit veal aviv o shear morishin vealav ketubbat ishsha uvaale chov. yorshe haav omrin met habben techilla velo hinniach kelum veavad hachov uvaale chovot omrim haav met techilla vezacha habben birushshato veyesh lanu ligbot mechelko. hare hannechasim bechezkat hayyorshin veal haishsha uvaale chovot lehavi reaya o yelchu lahem belo kelum: 
Din ellu shemmetu tachat hammappolet. o shettavu bayyam. o shennaflu laesh. o shemmetu beyom echad veze bimdina zo vehaacher bimdina acheret. din echad hu. shebbechol ellu vechayyotze bahen en yodin mi hu shemmet techilla:
Mishneh Torah, Inheritances 6: En adam yachol lehorish lemi sheeno rauy leyarsho velo laakor hayerushsha min hayyoresh af al pi shezze mamon hu. lefi shenneemar befarashat nechalot <small>(Bamidbar 27 11)</small> "vehayta livne yisrael lechukkat mishpat" lomar shechukka zo lo nishtanna veen hattenay moil bah. ben shetztzivva vehu bari ben shehaya shechiv mera ben al pe ben bichtav eno moil:

Lefichach haomer ish peloni beni bechori lo yittol pi shenayim. ish peloni beni lo yirash im echav. lo amar kelum. ish peloni yirasheni bemakom sheyyesh lo bat. bitti tirasheni bemakom sheyyesh lo ben. lo amar kelum. vechen kol kayyotze baze. aval hayu lo yorshin rabbim kegon banim rabbim o achim o banot veamar keshehu shechiv mera peloni achi yirasheni mikkelal echay o bitti pelonit tirasheni mikkelal benotay devarav kayyamin ben sheamar al pe ben shekkatav bichtav. aval im amar peloni beni yirasheni levaddo im amar al pe devarav kayyamin. aval im katav kol nechasav livno lo asahu ella appotroppos kemo shebbearnu:

Amar peloni beni yirash chatzi nechasay ushear banay hachetzi devarav kayyamin. aval im amar habbechor yirash kappashut o sheamar lo yirash pi shenayim im echav lo amar kelum shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21 16)</small> "lo yuchal levakker et ben haahuva al pene ven hassenua habbechor" <small>(Devarim 21 17)</small> "ki et habbechor ben hassenua yakkir":
Veim haya bari eno yachol lehosif velo ligroa lo labbechor velo leechad mishshear hayyorshin:

Bamme devarim amurim kesheamar bilshon yerushsha. aval im natan mattana devarav kayyamin. lefichach hamechallek nechasav al piv levanav keshehu shechiv mera ribba leechad umiet leechad vehishva lahen habbechor devarav kayyamin. veim amar mishshum yerushsha lo amar kelum:

Katav ben battechilla ben baemtza ben bassof mishshum mattana af al pi shehizkir leshon yerushsha battechilla uvassof devarav kayyamin. ketzad. tinnaten sade peloni lifloni beni veyirashenna. o sheamar yirashenna vetinnaten lo veyirashenna. o yirashenna vetinnaten lo. hoil veyesh sham leshon mattana af al pi shehizkir leshon yerushsha battechilla uvassof devarav kayyamin. vechen im hayu shalosh sadot lishlosha yorshin veamar yirash peloni sade pelonit vetinnaten lifloni sade pelonit veyirash peloni sade pelonit kanu. af al pi shezze sheamar lo bilshon yerushsha eno ze sheamar lo bilshon mattana. vehu shello yishhe ben amira laamira kede dibbur. aval im shaha tzarich sheyyehe leshon hammattana meorav bishlashtan:

Ketzad. im haya leshon hammattana baemtza yomar peloni ufeloni ufeloni yirshu sade peloni ufeloni ufeloni shennetattim lahen bemattana veyirashum. veim haya leshon hammattana battechilla yomar tinnaten sade peloni ufeloni ufeloni lifloni ufeloni ufeloni veyirashum. veim haya leshon hammattana bassof yomar yirash peloni ufeloni ufeloni sade peloni ufeloni ufeloni shennetattim lahen bemattana:
Yerushshat habbaal af al pi shehi middivrehem asu chizzuk ledivrehem keshel tora. veen hattenay moil bah ella im ken hitna immah keshehi arusa kemo shebbearnu behilchot ishut:
Haakkum yoresh et aviv devar tora. aval shear yerushshotehen mannichin oto lefi minhagam:

Vehagger eno yoresh et aviv haakkum ella middivrehem tikkenu lo sheyyirash keshehaya shemma yachzor lemirdo. veyerae li shettenay moil birushsha zo hoil veen haakkum mechuyyav laamod betakkanat chachamim. veen haakkum yoresh et aviv hagger velo ger yoresh et ger lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim:

Kol hannoten nechasav laacherim vehinniach hayyorshin. af al pi sheen hayyorshin nohagin (bo) kashshura en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu. vezachu haacherim bechol ma shennatan lahen. middat chasidut hi shello yaid adam chasid betzavvaa shemmaavirin bo hayerushsha min hayyoresh afillu mibben sheeno noheg kashshura leachiv chacham venoheg kashshura:

Yisrael shehemir yoresh et kerovav hayyisreelim keshehaya. veim rau bet din leabbed et mamono ulekanso shello yirash kede shello lechazzek et yedehem harshut beyadan. veim yesh lo banim beyisrael tinnaten yerushshat avihen hammumar lahen. vechen hamminhag tamid bammaarav:
Tziuu chachamim shello yeshanne adam ben habbanim bechayyav afillu bedavar muat shello yavou lide tacharut vekina kaache yosef im yosef:
Mishneh Torah, Inheritances 7: En hayyorshin nochalin ad sheyyaviu reaya berura shemmet morishan. aval im shamu bo shemmet o shebbau akkum mesichin lefi tumman. af al pi shemmassiin et ishto al pihem venotel ketubbatah en hayyorshin nochalin al pihem:

Haishsha shebbat veamra met bali af al pi shehi neemenet vetinnase vetittol ketubbatah en hayyorshin nichnasin lannachala al piha. amra met bali venityabbema hare yevamah nichnas lannachala al piha shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 6)</small> "yakum al shem achiv hammet" vahare kam:

Mi shettava bemayim sheen lahem sof uvau edim shettava bifnehem veavad zichro. af al pi sheen massiin et ishto lechattechilla hare hayyorshin nochalin al pihem. vechen im bau edim sherauhu shennafal legov arayot unemerim o sherauhu tzaluv vehaof ochel bo. o shennidkar bammilchama umet o shenneherag velo hikkiru panav aval hayu lo simanim muvhakin begufo vehikkiru otam. bechol ellu haddevarim vechayyotze bahen im avad zichro achar kach yordin lannachala beedut zo af al pi sheen massiin et ishto. sheani omer shello hechmiru bidvarim ellu ella mippene issur karet. aval leinyan mamon im heidu haedim bidvarim shechezkatan lemita veheidu sherau otan haddevarim veavad zichro veachar kach nishma shemmet hare ellu nochalin al pihen. vechaze maasim bechol yom bechol batte dinin velo shamanu mi shechalak bedavar ze:

Shavuy shennishba veshamu shemmet veyardu yorshav lannachala vechalku otah benehem en motziin otah miyyadan. vechen habboreach mechamat sakkana. aval hayyotze ledaat sheshshamu bo shemmet veyardu yorshav linchasav vechillekum motziin miyyadan ad sheyyaviu reaya shemmet morishan:

Shavuy shennishba uvarach mechamat sakkanat nefashot chayyavin bet din lehitassek benichsehen. ketzad osin. kol hammittaltelin yihyu mufkadin beyad neeman al pi bet din umoridin letoch hakkarkaot kerovin haruyin lirushsha kede laavod et hakkarkaot ulehitassek bahen ad sheyyivvada shemmetu o ad sheyyavou. velichsheyyavo hashshavuy vehabboreach shamin ellu hakkerovim shehuredu ma sheasu uma sheachlu keminhag kol haarisin shel otah hammedina. velamma lo yaamidu bet din appotroppos leolam ben bemittaltelim ben bekarkaot ad sheyyavou habbealim o ad sheyyivvada bevadday shemmetu. lefi sheen bet din chayyavin lehaamid appotroppos ligdolim shehen bene daat:

Nishba hashshavuy uvarach hamesukkan vehinniach kama liktzor vaanavim livtzor temarim ligdor vezetim limsok. bet din yordim linchasav umaamidin lahen appotroppos vekotzer uvotzer vegoder umosek umocher happerot. umannichin demehen im shear hammittaltelin bevet din veachar kach moridin hakkarov linchasav. sheim yered techilla shemma yitlosh ellu happerot shehen kitlushin veyochal otan. vehu haddin bachatzerot ufundakiyyot vachanuyyot haasuyot lesachar veenan tzerichin avoda velo torach veen adam noten otan baarisut. en moridin lahem yoresh shehare gove hassachar veochel. ella ketzad osin. bet din maamidin lahen gabbay veyihye hassachar munnach bevet din ad sheyyavi reaya shemmet o ad sheyyavo veyittol shello:
Veen moridin hakkarov leolam ella lesadot ulegannot ucheramim vechayyotze bahen sheyyihye bahen kearis kede shello yufsedu venimtzeu burim uneshammim:

Mi sheyyatza ledaat vehinniach nechasav veen yadua lehechan halach velo ma era lo. en moridin karov linchasav. veim yarad mesallekin oto. veen bet din tzerichin lehittappel bo ulehaamid lo appotroppos lo lakkarka velo lammittaltelin shehare ledato yatza vehinniach nechasav. vechetzad yihye din nichse ze. mittaltelin yaamdu beyad ze shehen tachat yado ad sheyyavo ze veyitba o ad sheyyamut veyitbeu hayyorshin:

Vehakkarkaot mi shehinnichu shachen en lokchin mimmennu sachar. vesade o kerem shehaya bahen aris yishshaaru kemo shehinnicho ad sheyyavo. vesade o kerem shehinnicham burim yishshaaru burim shehare hu birtzono ibbed mamono vaaveda ledaat en anu metzuvvin lehachezirah:
Shamu bo shemmet hare bet din motziin kol hammittaltelin umannichin otan etzel neeman al pihen umoridin hakkarov lassadot velakkeramim bahen kearis ad sheyyavi reaya berura shemmet o ad sheyyavo:
Mishneh Torah, Inheritances 8:
Keshemmoridin karov lenichse hashshavuy o boreach o lenichse hayyotze ledaat sheshshamu bo shemmet. lo yoridu katan shemma yafsid hannechasim. veen moridin karov lenichse katan shemma yiton veyomar ze chelki hammaggia li birushshati. vaafillu karov mechamat karov en moridin. ketzad. hayu shene achim echad gadol veechad katan venishba hakkatan o barach. en moridin haggadol letoch sadehu mippene shehakkatan eno yachol limchot. veshemma yachazik ze haach uleachar shanim yomar ze chelki shehiggia li birushshati umechamat yerusha bati. vaafillu ben achiv shel ze hakkatan hannishba en moridin oto linchasav shemma yomar shemmechamat avi yarashti chelek ze: 
Leolam en moridin karov lenichse katan afillu karov mechamat ache haem sheenan reuyin lirash. harechaka yetera hi zo vaafillu yesh benehen shetar chaluka ben bevattim ben besadot lo yered. vaafillu amar kitvu alay shetar arisut lo yered shemma yovdu hashshetarot veyaarchu hayyamim veyiton veyomar shezze chelek yerushsha ba lo (mechamato o) mechamat morishav. maase beishsha achat shehayu lah shalosh banot venishbet hazzekena hi uvat achat umeta bat sheniyya vehinnicha ben katan. veamru chachamim en moridin zo habbat hannishara lannechasim shemma meta hazzekena venimtzeu shelish nechasim ellu lakkatan veen moridin karov lenichse katan. vechen en moridin leze hakkatan bannechasim shemma adayin hazzekena bachayyim veen moridin katan lenichse shavuy. ella ketzad osin. mittoch shetztzarich lehaamid appotroppos lachatzi shel katan maamidin appotroppos al kol nichse hazzekena. achar zeman shamu shemmeta hazzekena amru chachamim tered habbat hannishara lishlish hannechasim shehu chelek yerushshatah veyered hakkatan lishlish shehu chelko minnichse hazzekena. vehashshelish shel bat hashshevuya maamidin lo appotroppos mippene chelek hakkatan shemma meta gam habbat hashshevuya veyesh leze hakkatan chatzi hashshelish shellah. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Inheritances 9:
Haachin sheadayin lo chalku yerushshat avihen ella kullan mishtammeshin beyachad bema shehinniach lahen hare hen keshuttafin lechol davar. vechen bishar hayyorshin hare hen shuttafin benichse morishan. vechol shennasa venatan kol echad mehen bemamon ze hassachar laemtza: 
Hayu hayyorshin gedolim uketannim vehishbichu haggedolim et hannechasim hishbichu laemtza. amru reu ma shehinniach lanu abba vahare anu osin veochlin. hashshevach shel mashbiach. vehu sheyyihye hashshevach mechamat hotzaa shehotzi hammashbiach. aval shavchu nechasim mechamat atzman hashshevach laemtza: 
Vechen im hayta ishto shel met hi hayyoreshet bichlal achyoteha o bichlal benot dodeha vehishbicha hannechasim hashshevach laemtza. veim amra reu ma shehinniach li bali vahareni osa veochelet hishbiach hannechasim mechamat hotzaa hare hashshevach shellah: 
Mi sheyyarash et aviv vehishbiach hannechasim venata uvana veachar kach noda sheyyesh lo achin bimdina acheret. im ketannim hen hashshevach laemtza veim hayu gedolim hoil velo noda sheyyesh lo achin shamin lo kearis. vechen ach sheyyarad lenichse katan vehishbiach en shamin lo kearis. ella hashshevach laemtza shehare lo birshut yarad: 
Echad min haachin shellakach maot veasa bahen sechora im haya talmid chacham gadol sheeno manniach torato shaa achat. hare hassachar shello sheen ze manniach torato umitassek letzorech echav: 
Echad min haachin shemminnahu hammelech gabbay o sofer shemmachnis umotzi bemamon hammelech. vechen kol kayyotze baze meavodat hammelachim. im mechamat avihen minnahu kegon shehaya avihen yadua bedavar ze veamar naamid tachtav beno kede laasot chesed im hayetomim. happeras sheyyittol vechol hassachar sheyyistakker baavoda lechol haachin. vaafillu haya chacham beyoter verauy lemannoto. veim mechamat atzmo minnuhu hare ze leatzmo: 
Echad min haachin shehaya nose venoten betoch habbayit vekana avadim bishmo levaddo. hilva laacherim vehaya shetar hachov bishmo levaddo. veamar maot ellu shehilveti o shekkaniti bahen avadim ellu shelli levaddi hen shennaflu li mibbet avi immi. o metzia matzati o mattana nittena li. alav lehavi reaya shennafla lo yerushsha acheret o matza metzia o zacha bemattana. vechen haishsha shehayta noset venotenet betoch habbayit vehayu onot shehen shitre mimkar avadim veshitre chovot yotzot al shemah. veamra shelli hen shennaflu li mibbet avotay. aleha lehavi reaya shennaflu lah lirushsha. vechen almana shehayta noset venotenet benichse yetomim vehayu onot ushetarot yotzot al shemah veamra mirushsha naflu li o metzia matzati o mattana nittena li. aleha lehavi reaya. veim yesh lah neduneya veamra minneduneyati lakachti neemenet aval im en lah neduneya velo hevia reaya hare hakkol bechezkat hayyorshin: 
Bamme devarim amurim beachim uvealmana sheen chalukin beissatan. aval im hayu chalukin beissatan shemma meissato kamatz veal haachin lehavi reaya shehen mishshel emtza. vechen im met ze hannoten vehannose betoch habbayit al haachin lehavi reaya af al pi shello hayu chalukin beissatan: 
Echad min haachin sheshshetar chov yotze mittachat yado alav lehavi reaya sheaviv netano lo bichtiva umesira. o shetztzivva lo bo keshehu shechiv mera. veim lo hevi reaya hare hu laemtza: 
Bamme devarim amurim beachin mippene shechezkatan shomtin ze mizze. aval acher shettaan shennatan lo o shekkanahu mibbealav gove bo veeno tzarich lehavi reaya: 
Echad min haachin shennatal matayim zuz lilmod tora o lilmod ummanut yecholin haachin lomar lo im en atta etzlenu en lecha mezonot ella lefi birkat habbayit. sheen hotzaat mezonot haechad levaddo kehotzaat mezonotav ben rabbim: 
Mi shemmet vehinniach banim gedolim uketannim en haggedolim mitparnesim parnasat hakketannim velo hakketannim nizzonim mezonot haggedolim ella cholkim beshave. nisseu gedolim leachar mitat avihen yisu hakketannim ken mikkelal hannechasim veachar kach yachaloku. nisseu haggedolim bechayye avihen veamru hakketannim leachar mitat avihen hare anu nosin kederech shennesatem attem. en shomin lahen ella ma shennatan lahem avihem natan: 
Hissi haav et beno veasa lo mishte vehayta hahotzaa mishshel av venishtallecha shoshvinut leze habben bechayye haav. keshehi chozeret leachar mitat haav chozeret laemtza. aval hotzi habben bammishte mishshello enah chozeret ella mechelek habben shennishtallecha lo bilvad: 
Haav sheshshalach shoshvinut beshem echad mibbanav keshettachzor hashshoshvinut leoto habben hare hi shello. aval im shelachah haav beshem banav setam keshettachzor tachzor laemtza. veen ze shennishtallecha lo chayyav lehachezirah ad sheyyismechu immo habbanim kullan. shehare kullan shoshvinin shebbeshem kullan nishtallecha. lefichach im sameach bemiktzatan machzir chelek ze shessamach immo bilvad vahare hu laemtza: 
Gedol haachin shehaya lovesh umitkasse malbushin naim im yesh laachim hanaa mimmennu kede sheyyihyu devarav nishmain hare ze lovesh mittefisat habbayit:
Mishneh Torah, Inheritances 10: Shenne achim shechalku uva lahen ach mimmedinat hayyam. vechen shelosha achin shechalku uva baal chov venatal chelko shel echad mehen. afillu natal ze karka veze kesafim batla machloket vechozrin vecholkin hashshear beshave:

Mi shetztzivva bishat mitato sheyyittenu lifloni dekel o sade minnechasav vechalku haachin velo natnu lifloni kelum. hare hammachaloket betela. vechetzad osin. notnin ma shetztzivva morishan veachar kach chozrin vecholkin kattechilla:

Haachin shechalku shamin lahen ma shealehen. aval ma sheal benehen uvenotehen shekkanu lahen mittefisat habbayit en shamin. vechen ma sheal neshotehen. shekkevar zachu bahen leatzman. bamme devarim amurim bevigde chol. aval bevigde shabbat umoed shamin ma shealehen:

Mi shehinniach yetomim miktzatan gedolim umiktzatan ketannim veratzu lachlok benichse avihen kede sheyyittelu haggedolim chelkan. maamidin bet din appotroppos lakketannim uvorer lahen hachelek hayyafe. veim higdilu enan yecholin limchot shehare al pi bet din chalku lahem. veim tau bet din bashshuma ufachatu shetut. yecholin limchot vecholkin chaluka acheret achar shehigdilu:

Mi shemmet vehinniach yorshin gedolim uketannim tzarich lemannot appotroppos sheyyihye mitassek bechelek hakkatan ad sheyyagdil. veim lo minna chayyavin bet din lehaamid lahen appotroppos ad sheyyagdilu. shebbet din hu avihen shel yetomim:

Tzivva hammorish veamar yinnaten chelek hakkatan lakkatan uma sheyyirtze yaase bah harshut beyado. vechen im minna hammorish appotroppos al hakketannim katan o ishsha o eved harshut beyado. aval en bet din memannin appotroppos lo ishsha velo eved velo katan velo am haaretz. shehu bechezkat chashud al haaverot. ella bodkin al adam neeman veish chayil veyodea lehappech bizchut hayetomim vetoen taanatam vesheyyesh lo koach beiske haolam kede lishmor nechasim uleharviach bahen umaamidin oto al hakketannim. ben sheyyihye rachok ben sheyyihye karov lakkatan. ella sheim haya karov lo yered lakkarkaot:

Bet din sheheemidu appotroppos veshamu alav shehu ochel veshote umotzi hotzaot yeter middavar shehaya amud bo yesh lahen lachush lo shemma minnichse yetomim hu ochel umesallekin oto umaamidin acher. aval im minnahu avi yetomim en mesallekin oto shemma metzia matza. aval im bau edim shehu mafsid nichse yetomim mesallekin oto. uchevar hiskimu haggeonim shemmashbiin oto hoil umafsid. vehu haddin leappotroppos shemminnahu avi yetomim vehayta shemuato tova vehaya yashar verodef mitzvot vechazar lihyot zolel vesove veholech bedarche hachashad o shepparatz bindarim uvaavak gezel bet din chayyavim lesallek oto ulehashbio. ulemannot lahen appotroppos kasher. vechol haddevarim haellu kefi ma sheyyerae laddayyan shekkol bet din uvet din hu avihen shel yetomim:

Katan shehigdil afillu haya ochel veshote yoter midday umafsid veholech bederech raa en bet din monin mimmennu mamono veen maamidin lo appotroppos. ella im ken tzivva aviv o morisho shello yittenu lo ella im ken yihye kasher umatzliach o shello yittenu lo ad zeman merubbe. vehashshote vehacheresh hare hen kiktannim umaamidin lahen appotroppos:
Mishneh Torah, Inheritances 11: Maot shel yetomim shehinniach lahen avihen enan tzerichin appotroppos. ella ketzad osin bahen. bodkin al mi sheyyesh lo nechasim sheyyesh lahem acharayut veyihyu iddit veyihye ish neeman veshomea dine tora umeolam lo kibbel alav nidduy. venotnin lo hammaot bevet din karov lesachar verachok lehefsed venimtzeu hayetomim nehenin missechar hammaot. vechen im en lo karka yinnaten lahen mashkon zahav shavur sheen bo siman venotlin bet din hammashkon venotnin lo hammaot karov lesachar verachok lehefsed. velamma lo yikchu mashkon kelim shel zahav o chali shel zahav. shemma shel acherim hu veyittenu siman veyitteluhu achar moto im yeda haddayyan sheen ze amud. vechamma yifseku besachar. kefi ma sheyyiru haddayyanin. o shelish hassachar o chetzyo afillu revia hassachar laytomim im rau shezzo takkana lahem osin. lo matzu adam sheyyittenu lo hammaot rachok lehefsed vekarov lesachar hare ellu motziin mehen mezonot meat. ad sheyyiknu lahen bammaot karka veyimseru oto beyad appotroppos sheyyaamidu lahen:
Kol hammittaltelin shel yetomim shamin otan umochrin otan bevet din. veim haya hashshuk karov lammedina. molichin otan lashshuk umochrin otan veyitztarfu demehen im hammaot shel yetomim:

Mi shehaya beyado shechar shel yetomim im yannicho kan ad sheyyimmacher shemma yachmitz. veim yolicho lashshuk shemma yeero ones badderech. hare ze ose bo kederech shehu ose beshello. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Keshemmaamidin bet din lahen appotroppos mosrin lo kol nichse hakkatan hakkarka vehammittaltelin shello nimkeru. vehu motzi umachnis uvone vesoter veshover venotea vezorea veose kefi ma sheyyire shezze tov laytomim umaachilan umashkan venoten lahen kol hahotzaa kefi hammamon uchefi harauy lahen velo yarvichu lahen yoter midday velo yetzamtzem alehem yeter midday:

Kesheyyagdilu hayetomim noten lahem mamon morishan veeno tzarich laasot lahen cheshbonot ma shehichnis vehotzi ella omer lahen ze hannishar. venishba binkitat chefetz shello gezalan kelum. bamme devarim amurim keshemminnuhu bet din. aval appotroppos shemminnahu avi yetomim vechen shear hammorishan eyino nishba al taanat safek. yesh leappotroppos lilbosh ulehitkassot minnichse yetomim kede sheyyihye mechubbad veyihyu devarav nishmain vehu sheyyihye laytomim hanaa benichsehen bihyot devarav nishmain:

Yesh leappotroppos limkor behema vaavadim shefachot sadot ucheramim lehaachil laytomim. aval en mochrin umannichin hammaot veen mochrin sadot likkach avadim velo avadim likkach sadot shemma lo yatzliach. aval mochrin sade likkach shevarim laavodat sadot acherot shehashshevarim hen ikkar kol nichse sadot:

En haappotroppin rashshain limkor berachok veligl bekarov limkor beraa veligl beyafa. shemma lo yatzliach ze shekkanu. veen rashshain ladun velachuv al menat lizkot laytomim shemma lo yizku venimtza hachov kayyam:

En haappotroppin rashshain lehotzi avadim lecherut afillu likkach min haeved damim sheyyetze lecherut. aval mochrin otan laacherim velokchin mehen haddamim al menat sheyyotziuhu lecherut veotan haa [che] rim hen shemmesha [ch] rerin otam:

Haappotroppin tormin umeasserin nichse yetomim kede lehaachilan. sheen maachilin et hayetomim davar haasur. aval lo yeasseru velo yitromu kede lehanniach perot metukkanin ella yimkeru otan tevel veharotze letakken yetakken:

Haappotroppin osin lakketannim lulav vesukka vetzitzit veshofar sefer tora utefillin umezuzot umegilla. kelalo shel davar kol mitzvot ase sheyyesh lahem kitzva ben shehu middivre tora ben shehu middivre sofrim. osin lahem af al pi sheenan chayyavin bemitzva mikkol ellu hammitzvot ella kede lechannechan. aval en poskin alehen tzedaka vaafillu lefidyon shevuyim. mippene shemmitzvot ellu en lahen kitzva:
Umi shennishtatta o shennitcharesh bet din poskin alav tzedaka im haya rauy:

Af al pi sheen haappotroppos tzarich laasot cheshbon kemo shebbearnu. tzarich lachshov beno leven atzmo ledakdek ulehizzaher harebe meavihen shel ellu hayetomim shehu rochev aravot shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 68 5)</small> "slu larochev baaravot" vegomer <small>(Tehillim 68 6)</small> "avi yetomim" vegomer:
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 1:
Shalosh mitzvot nitztauu yisrael bishat kenisatan laaretz. lemannot lahem melech shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 15)</small> "som tasim alecha melech". ulehachrit zaro shel amalek shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 19)</small> "timche et zecher amalek". velivnot bet habbechira shenneemar <small>(Devarim 12 5)</small> "leshichno tidreshu uvata shamma": 
Minnuy melech kodem lemilchemet amalek. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 15 1)</small> "oti shalach Adonai limshochocha lemelech" <small>(Shmuel 1 15 3)</small> "atta lech vehikkita et amalek". vehacheratat zera amalek kodemet levinyan habbayit. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 7 1)</small> "vayhi ki yashav hammelech beveto vaAdonai heniach lo missaviv mikkol oyvav" <small>(Shmuel 2 7 2)</small> "vayyomer hammelech el natan hannavi anochi yoshev bevet arazim" vegomer. meachar shehakamat melech mitzva lamma lo ratza hakkadosh baruch hu kesheshshaalu melech mishshemuel. lefi sheshshaalu betaromet. velo shaalu lekayyem hammitzva ella mippene shekkatzu bishmuel hannavi. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 8 7)</small> "ki lo otcha maasu ki oti maasu" vegomer: 
En maamidin melech battechilla ella al pi bet din shel shivim zekenim veal pi navi. kihoshua shemminnahu moshe rabbenu uvet dino. ucheshaul vedavid shemminnam shemuel haramati uvet dino: 
En maamidin melech mikkehal gerim afillu achar kamma dorot ad shettihye immo miyyisrael. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 15)</small> "lo tuchal latet alecha ish nachri asher lo achicha hu". velo lemalchut bilvad ella lechol serarot shebbeyisrael. lo sar tzava velo sar chamishshim o sar asara. afillu memunne al ammat hammayim shemmechallek mimmenna lassadot. veen tzarich lomar dayyan o nasi shello yehe ella miyyisrael. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 15)</small> "mikkerev achecha tasim alecha melech" kol mesimot sheatta mesim lo yehu ella mikkerev achecha: 
En maamidin ishsha bemalchut shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 15)</small> "alecha melech" velo malka. vechen kol mesimot shebbeyisrael en memannim bahem ella ish: 
Veen maamidin melech velo kohen gadol. lo katztzav. velo sappar. velo ballan [1.] velo bursi. lo mippene shehen pesulin ella hoil veummanutan nikla haam mezalzelin bahen leolam. umishsheyyaase bimlacha meellu yom echad nifsal: 
Keshemmaamidin hammelech moshchin oto beshemen hammishcha. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 10 1)</small> "vayyikkach shemuel et pach hashshemen vayyitzok al rosho vayyishshakehu". umeachar shemmoshchin hammelech hare ze zoche lo ulevanav ad olam. shehammalchut yerushsha shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 20)</small> "lemaan yaarich yamim al mamlachto hu uvanav bekerev yisrael". heniach ben katan meshammerin lo hammelucha ad sheyyagdil. kemo sheasa yehoyada leyoash. vechol hakkodem benachala kodem lirushshat hammelucha. vehabben haggadol kodem lekatan mimmennu. velo hammalchut bilvad ella kol hasserarot vechol hamminnuyin shebbeyisrael yerushsha livno uleven beno ad olam. vehu sheyyihye habben memalle mekom avotav bechachma uveyira. haya memalle beyira af al pi sheeno memalle bechachma maamidin oto bimkom aviv umelammedin oto. vechol mi sheen bo yirat shamayim af al pi shechachmato merubba en memannin oto leminnuy min hamminnuyin shebbeyisrael. kevan shennimshach david zacha becheter malchut. vahare hammalchut lo ulevanav hazzecharim ad olam. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 7 16)</small> "kisacha yihye nachon ad olam". velo zacha ella lichsherim shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 132 12)</small> "im yishmeru vanecha beriti". af al pi shello zacha ella lichsherim lo tikkaret hammelucha mizzera david leolam. hakkadosh baruch hu hivticho bechach shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 89 lo)</small> "im yaazvu vanav torati uvemishpatay lo yelechun" <small>(Tehillim 89 33)</small> "ufakadti veshevet pisham uvingaim avonam" <small>(Tehillim 89 34)</small> "vechasdi lo afir meimmo": 
Navi sheheemid melech mishshear shivte yisrael. vehaya oto hammelech holech bederech hattora vehammitzva venilcham milchamot Adonai. hare ze melech vechol mitzvot hammalchut nohagot bo. af al pi sheikkar hammalchut ledavid. veyihye mibbanav melech. shehare achiyya hashshiloni heemid yaravam veamar lo <small>(Melachim 1 11 38)</small> "vehaya im shamoa tishma et kol asher atzavvecha uvaniti lecha vayit neeman kaasher baniti ledavid" vegomer. veamar lo achiyya <small>(Melachim 1 11 36)</small> "velivno etten shevet echad lemaan heyot nir ledavid avdi kol hayyamim lefanay birushalami": 
Malche bet david hem haomdim leolam shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 7 16)</small> "kisacha yihye nachon ad olam". aval im yaamod melech mishshear yisrael tippasek hammalchut mibbeto. shehare neemar leyaravam <small>(Melachim 1 11 39)</small> "ach lo chol hayyamim": 
En moshchin malche yisrael beshemen hammishcha ella beshemen afarsemon. veen memannin otan birushalayim leolam ella melech yisrael mizzera david. veen moshchin ella zera david: 
Keshemmoshchin malche bet david en moshchin otan ella al hammayan: 
Veen moshchin melech ben melech. ella im ken hayta sham machloket o milchama moshchin oto kede lesallek hammachaloket. lefichach mashchu shelomo mippene adoniyya. veyoash mippene atalya. umashchu yehoachaz mippene yehoyakim achiv:
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 2:
Kavod gadol nohagin bammelech. umesimin lo ema veyira belev kol adam. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 15)</small> "som tasim" shettehe emato alecha. en rochvin al suso. veen yoshvin al kiso. veen mishtammeshin besharvito. velo bechitro. velo beechad mikkol kele tashmishav. ucheshehu met kullan nisrafin lefanav. vechen lo yishtammesh baavadav veshifchotav veshammashav ella melech acher. lefichach avishag hayta mutteret lishlomo vaasura laadoniyya: 
Aval ishto shel melech enah nivelet leacher leolam. afillu hammelech eno nose almanato o gerushato shel melech acher: 
Veasur liroto keshehu erom velo keshehu mistapper. velo keshehu bevet hammerchatz. velo keshehu mistappeg. veeno choletz shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 9)</small> "veyarka befanav" veze bizzayon. vaafillu ratza en shomin lo. shehammelech shemmachal al kevodo en kevodo machul. vehoil veeno choletz eno meyabbem. vechen [im met hu] kevan shei efshar leyabbem et ishto kach en choltzin lah ella teshev leolam bezikkatah: 
Met lo met eno yotze mippetach palterin shello. ucheshemmavrin oto kol haam mesubbin al haaretz vehu mesev al haddargash. veim nichnas laazara vehaya mizzera david yeshev. sheen yeshiva baazara ella lemalche bet david bilvad. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 7 18)</small> "vayyavo hammelech david vayyeshev lifne Adonai": 
Hammelech mistapper bechol yom. umetakken atzmo umitnae bemalbushin naim umefoarim. shenneemar <small>(yeshaya log 17)</small> "melech beyafyo techezena enecha". veyoshev al kisse malchuto bappalterin shello. umesim keter berosho. vechol haam bain elav beet sheyyirtze. veomdin lefanav umishtachavim artza. afillu navi omed lifne hammelech mishtachave artza. shenneemar <small>(Melachim 1 1 23)</small> "hinne natan hannavi vayyavo lifne hammelech vayyishtachu lammelech". aval kohen gadol eno ba lifne hammelech ella im ratza. veeno omed lefanav ella hammelech omed lifne kohen gadol. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 27 21)</small> "velifne elazar hakkohen yaamod". af al pi chen mitzva al kohen gadol lechabbed et hammelech ulehoshivo velaamod mippanav kesheyyavo lo. velo yaamod hammelech lefanav ella kesheyyishal lo bemishpat haurim. vechen mitzva al hammelech lechabbed lomde hattora. uchesheyyikkansu lefanav sanhedrin vechachme yisrael yaamod lifnehem veyoshivem betziddo. vechen haya yehoshafat melech yehuda ose afillu letalmid chacham haya omed mikkiso umenashsheko vekore lo rabbi umori. bamme devarim amurim bizman sheyyihye hammelech beveto levaddo hu vaavadav yaase ze betzina. aval befarhesya bifne haam lo yaase. velo yaamod mippene adam. velo yedabber rakkot. velo yikra leadam ella bishmo kede shettehe yirato belev hakkol: 
Kederech shechalak lo hakkatuv hakkavod haggadol. vechiyyev hakkol bichvodo. kach tzivvahu lihyot libbo bekirbo shafal vechalal shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 109 22)</small> "velibbi chalal bekirbi". velo yinhag gassut lev beyisrael yeter midday shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 20)</small> "levilti rum levavo meechav". veyihye chonen umerachem liktannim ugedolim. veyetze veyavo becheftzehem uvetovatam. veyachus al kevod katan shebbakketannim. ucheshemmedabber el kol hakkahal bilshon rabbim yedabber rakkot. shenneemar <small>(divrei hayamim 1 28 2)</small> "shemauni achay veammi". veomer <small>(Melachim 1 12 7)</small> "im hayyom tihye eved laam hazze" vegomer. leolam yitnaheg baanava yetera. en lanu gadol mimmoshe rabbenu vehu omer <small>(Shemot 16 8)</small> "venachnu ma lo alenu telunnotechem". veyisbol tarcham umassaam utelunotam vekitzpam kaasher yissa haomen et hayyonek. roe kerao hakkatuv. lirot beyaakov ammo. vedarko shel roe meforash bekabbala keroe edro yire bizroo yekabbetz telaim uvecheko yissa vegomer:
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 3:
Beet sheyyeshev hammelech al kisse malchuto kotev lo sefer tora leatzmo yeter al hassefer shehinnichu lo avotav. umaggiho missefer haazara al pi bet din shel shivim veechad. im lo hinnichu lo avotav o shenneevad kotev shene sifre tora. echad mannicho bevet genazav shehu metzuvve bo kechol echad miyyisrael. vehashsheni lo yazuz millefanav ella beet sheyyikkanes levet hakkisse. o levet hammerchatz. o lemakom sheen rauy likria. yotze lammilchama vehu immo. nichnas vehu immo. yoshev baddin vehu immo. mesev vehu kenegdo shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 19)</small> "vehayta immo vekara vo kol yeme chayyav": 
Lo yarbe lo nashim. mippi hashshemua lamdu shehu lokeach ad shemone esre nashim ben hannashim ufillagshim hakkol shemone esre. veim hosif achat uvealah loke. veyesh lo legaresh velissa acheret tachat zo sheggeresh: 
Velo yarbe lo susim ella kede merkavto. afillu sus echad panuy lihyot ratz lefanav kederech sheosin shear hammelachim asur. veim hosif loke: 
Velo yarbe lo kesef vezahav lehanniach bignazav ulehitgaot bo o lehitnaot bo. ella kede sheyyitten lechelotav velaavadav uleshammashav. vechol kesef vezahav sheyyarbe leotzar bet Adonai velihyot sham muchan letzarche hatztzibbur ulemilchamotam hare ze mitzva lehareboto. veen asur ella leharebot leatzmo bevet genazav shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 17)</small> "velo yarbe lo". veim hirba loke: 
Hammelech asur lishtot derech shichrut. shenneemar <small>(Mishlei lo 4)</small> "al lamlachim sheto yayin". ella yihye osek battora uvetzarche yisrael bayyom uvallayla. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 19)</small> "vehayta immo vekara vo kol yeme chayyav": 
Vechen lo yihye shatuf benashim. afillu lo hayta lo ella achat lo yihye matzuy etzlah tamid kishar hattippeshim. shenneemar <small>(Mishlei lo 3)</small> "al titten lannashim chelecha". al hasarat libbo hikpida tora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 17)</small> "velo yasur levavo". shellibbo hu lev kol kehal yisrael lefichach dibbeko hakkatuv battora yeter mishshear haam shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 19)</small> "kol yeme chayyav": 
Kevar bearnu shemmalche bet david danin otan umeidin alehen. aval malche yisrael gazru chachamim shello yadun velo danin oto. velo meid velo meidin alav. mippene shellibban gas bahen veyavo min haddavar takkala vehefsed al haddat: 
Kol hammored bemelech yisrael yesh lammelech reshut lehargo. afillu gazar al echad mishshear haam sheyyelech lemakom peloni velo halach o shello yatza mibbeto veyatza chayyav mita. veim ratza lehargo yehareg. shenneemar <small>(Yehoshua 1 18)</small> "kol ish asher yamre et picha". vechen kol hamevazze et hammelech o hamecharfo yesh lammelech reshut lehargo. keshimi ben gera. veen lammelech reshut laharog ella besayif bilvad. veyesh lo leesor ulehakkot beshotin lichvodo. aval lo yafkir mamon veim hifkir hare ze gezel: 
Hamevattel gezerat hammelech bishvil shennitassek bemitzvot. afillu bemitzva kalla hare ze patur. divre harav vedivre haeved divre harav kodmin. veen tzarich lomar im gazar hammelech levattel mitzva sheen shomin lo: 
Kol hahoreg nefashot shello biraya berura. o belo hateraa. afillu beed echad. o sone sheharag bishgaga. yesh lammelech reshut lehargo uletakken haolam kefi ma shehashshaa tzericha. vehoreg rabbim beyom echad vetole umannichan teluyim yamim rabbim lehatil ema uleshabber yad rishe haolam:
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 4:
Reshut yesh lammelech litten mas al haam litzrachav o letzorech hammilchamot. vekotzev lo meches veasur lehaveriach min hammeches. sheyyesh lo ligzor shekkol mi sheyyignov hammeches yillakach mamono o yehareg shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 8 17)</small> "veattem tihyu lo laavadim". ulehallan hu omer <small>(Devarim 20 11)</small> "yihyu lecha lamas vaavaducha". mikkan shennoten mas vekotzev meches vedinav bechol ellu haddevarim vechayyotze bahen din. shekkol haamur befarashat melech melech zoche bo: 
Vesholeach bechol gevul yisrael velokeach min haam haggibborim veanshe chayil veose mehen chayil lemerkavto uvefarashav umaamid mehen omdim lefanav. umaamid mehen anashim larutz lefanav. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 8 11)</small> "vesam lo bemerkavto ufarashav veratzu lifne merkavto". velokeach min hayyafim shebbahem lihyot shammashim veomdim lefanav shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 8 16)</small> "veet bachurechem hattovim" <small>(Shmuel 1 8 16)</small> "yikkach veasa limlachto": 
Vechen lokeach min baale haummanuyyot kol ma shehu tzarich veosin lo melachto venoten secharan. velokeach kol habbehemot vehaavadim vehashshefachot limlachto venoten secharan o demehen. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 8 12)</small> "velacharsh charisho veliktzor ketziro velaasot kele milchamto uchele richbo". <small>(Shmuel 1 8 16)</small> "veet avdechem veet shifchotechem veet bachurechem hattovim veet chamorechem yikkach veasa limlachto": 
Vechen lokeach mikkol gevul yisrael nashim ufilagshim. nashim bichtubba vekiddushin. ufilagshim belo ketubba uvelo kiddushin. ella beyichud bilvad kone otah umutteret lo. aval hahedyot asur befilegesh ella beama haivriyya bilvad achar yiud. veyesh lo [reshut] laasot happilagshim shellokeach learmono tabbachot veofot verakkachot. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 8 13)</small> "veet benotechem yikkach lerakkachot uletabbachot uleofot": 
Vechen kofe et haruyin lihyot sarim umemanne otam sare alafim vesare chamishshim. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 8 12)</small> "velasum lo sare alafim vesare chamishshim": 
Velokeach hassadot vehazzetim vehakkeramim laavadav kesheyyelchu lammilchama veyifshetu al mekomot ellu im en lahem ma yochlu ella mishsham. venoten demehen. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 8 14)</small> "veet sedotechem veet karmechem vezetechem hattovim yikkach venatan laavadav": 
Veyesh lo maaser min hazzeraim umin hailanot umin habbehema. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 8 15)</small> "vezarechem vecharmechem yasor" vegomer. <small>(Shmuel 1 8 17)</small> "tzonchem yasor": 
Hammelech hammashiach notel mikkol haaratzot shekkovshin yisrael chelek echad mishshelosha asar. vedavar ze chok lo ulevanav ad olam: 
Kol haruge hammelech mamonan lammelech. vechol hammamlachot shekkovesh hare otzrot hammelachim lammelech. ushear habbizza shebbozzin bozzin venotnin lefanav vehu notel mechetza barosh. umachatzit habbizza cholkin otah kol anshe hatztzava beyachad im haam hayyoshvin al hakkelim bammachane leshamram cholkin beshave. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 30 24)</small> "ki kechelek hayyored bammilchama uchechelek hayyshev al hakkelim yachdav yachaloku": 
Kol haaretz shekkovesh hare hi shello venoten laavadav uleanshe hammilchama kefi ma sheyyirtze. umanniach leatzmo kefi ma sheyyirtze. uvechol ellu haddevarim dino din. uvechol yihyu maasav leshem shamayim. vetihye megammato umachshavto leharim dat haemet. ulemalleot haolam tzedek. velishbor zeroa harshaim ulehillachem milchamot Adonai. sheen mamlichin melech techilla ella laasot mishpat umilchamot. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 8 20)</small> "ushefatanu malkenu veyatza lefanenu venilcham et milchamotenu":
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 5:
En hammelech nilcham techilla ella milchemet mitzva. vee zo hi milchemet mitzva zo milchemet shiva amamim. umilchemet amalek. veezrat yisrael miyyad tzar shebba alehem. veachar kach nilcham bemilchemet harshut vehi hammilchama shennilcham im shear haammim kede leharechiv gevul yisrael uleharbot bigdullato veshimo: 
Milchemet mitzva eno tzarich littol bah reshut bet din. ella yotze meatzmo bechol et. vechofe haam latzet. aval milchemet harshut eno motzi haam bah ella al pi bet din shel shivim veechad: 
Uforetz laasot lo derech veen memachin beyado. vederech hammelech en lah shiur. ella kefi ma shehu tzarich. eno meakkem hadderachim mippene karmo shel ze o mippene sadehu shel ze. ella holech beshave veose milchamto: 
Mitzvat ase lehacharim shiva amamin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20 17)</small> "hacharem tacharimem". vechol shebba leyado echad mehen velo harago over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20 16)</small> "lo techayye kol neshama". uchevar avad zichram: 
Vechen mitzvat ase leabbed zecher amalek. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 19)</small> "timche et zecher amalek". umitzvat ase lizkor tamid maasav haraim vaarivato. kede leorer evato. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 25 17)</small> "zachor et asher asa lecha amalek". mippi hashshemua lamdu zachor bappe lo tishkach ballev. sheasur lishkoach evato vesinato: 
Kol haaratzot shekkovshin yisrael bemelech al pi bet din. hare ze kibbush rabbim vahare hi keeretz yisrael shekkavash yehoshua lechol davar. vehu shekkavshu achar kibbush kol eretz yisrael haamura battora: 
Umuttar lishkon bechol haolam chutz meeretz mitzrayim. min hayyam haggadol vead hammaarav arba meot parsa al arba meot parsa keneged eretz kush ucheneged hammidbar. hakkol asur lehityashshev bah. bishlosha mekomot hizhira tora shello lashuv lemitzrayim. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 16)</small> "lo tosifun lashuv badderech hazze od". <small>(Devarim 28 68)</small> "lo tosif od lirotah". <small>(Shemot 14 13)</small> "lo tosifu lirotam od ad olam". vaalekkesanderia bichlal haissur: 
Muttar lachzor leeretz mitzrayim lischora velifrakmatya. velichbosh aratzot acherot. veen asur ella lehishtakea sham. veen lokin al lav ze. shebbeet hakkenisa muttar hu. veim yachashov leshev ulehishtakea sham en bo maase. veyerae li sheim kavash eretz mitzrayim melech yisrael al pi bet din shehi mutteret. velo hizhira ella lashuv lah yechidim o lishkon bah vehi beyad akkum mippene shemmaaseha mekulkalin yoter mikkol haaratzot. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 3)</small> "kemaase eretz mitzrayim": 
Asur latzet meeretz yisrael lechutza laaretz leolam. ella lilmod tora o lissa ishsha o lehatztzil min haakkum. veyachzor laaretz. vechen yotze hu lischora. aval lishkon bechutza laaretz asur ella im ken chazak sham haraav ad shennaasa sheve dinar chittin bishne dinarin. bamme devarim amurim keshehayu hammaot metzuyot vehapperot beyoker. aval im happerot bezol velo yimtza maot velo bema yistakker veavda peruta min hakkis. yetze lechol makom sheyyimtza bo revach. veaf al pi shemmuttar latzet enah middat chasidut shehare machlon vechilyon shene gedole haddor hayu umippene tzara gedola yatzu venitchayyevu kelaya lammakom: 
Gedole hachachamim hayu menashshekin al techume eretz yisrael umenashshekin avaneha umitgalgelin al afarah. vechen hu omer <small>(Tehillim 102 15)</small> "ki ratzu avadecha et avaneha veet afarah yechonenu": 
Amru chachamim kol hashshochen beeretz yisrael avonotav mechulin. shenneemar <small>(yeshaya log kad)</small> "uval yomar shachen chaliti haam hayyshev bah nesu avon". afillu halach bah arba ammot zoche lechayye haolam habba. vechen hakkavur bah nitkapper lo. ucheillu hammakom shehu bo mizbach kappara. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 32 43)</small> "vechipper admato ammo". uvappuranut hu omer <small>(Amos 7 17)</small> "al adama temea tamut". veeno dome kolatto mechayyim lekolatto achar moto. veaf al pi chen gedole hachachamim hayu molichim metehem lesham. tze ulemad miyyaakov avinu veyosef hatztzaddik: 
Leolam yadur adam beeretz yisrael afillu beir sherubbah akkum veal yadur bechutza laaretz vaafillu beir sherubbah yisrael. shekkol hayyotze lechutza laaretz keillu oved avoda zara. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 26 19)</small> "ki gershuni hayyom mehistappeach benachalat Adonai lemor lech avod elohim acherim". uvappuranuyyot hu omer <small>(Yechezkel 13 9)</small> "veel admat yisrael lo yavou". keshem sheasur latzet mehaaretz lechutza laaretz kach asur latzet mibbavel lishar haaratzot. shenneemar <small>(yirmeya 27 22)</small> "bavela yuvau veshamma yihyu":
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 6: En osin milchama im adam baolam ad shekkorin lo shalom. echad milchemet harshut veechad milchemet mitzva. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20, 10)</small> "ki tikrav el ir lehillachem aleha vekarata eleha leshalom". im hishlimu vekibbelu sheva mitzvot shennitztauu bene noach alehen en horgin mehen neshama vahare hen lemas. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20, 11)</small> "yihyu lecha lamas vaavaducha". kibbelu alehen hammas velo kibbelu haavdut o shekkibbelu haavdut velo kibbelu hammas. en shomin lahem ad sheyyekabbelu shenehem. vehaavdut sheyyekabbelu hu sheyyihyu nivzim ushefalim lematta velo yarimu rosh beyisrael ella yihyu kevushim tachat yadam. velo yitmannu al yisrael leshum davar shebbaolam. vehammas sheyyekabbelu sheyyihyu muchanim laavodat hammelech begufam umamonam. kegon binyan hachomot. vechozek hammetzudot. uvinyan armon hammelech vechayyotze bo. shenneemar <small>(Melachim 1 9, 15)</small> "veze devar hammas asher heela hammelech shelomo livnot et bet Adonai veet beto veet hammillo veet chomat yerushalami" <small>(Melachim 1 9, 19)</small> "veet kol are hammiskenot asher hayu lishlomo" <small>(Melachim 1 9, 20)</small> "kol haam hannotar min haemori" <small>(Melachim 1 9, 21)</small> "vayyaalem shelomo lemas oved ad hayyom hazze" <small>(Melachim 1 9, 22)</small> "umibbene yisrael lo natan shelomo aved ki hem anshe hammilchama vaavadav vesarav veshalishav vesare richbo ufarashav":
Veyesh lammelech lehatenot immahem sheyyikkach chatzi mamonam o hakkarkaot veyanniach kol hammittaltelin o hammittaltelim veyanniach hakkarkaot kefi ma sheyyatne:
Veasur leshakker bivritam ulechazzev lahem achar shehishlimu vekibbelu sheva mitzvot:

Veim lo hishlimu o shehishlimu velo kibbelu sheva mitzvot. osin immahem milchama vehorgin kol hazzecharim haggedolim. uvozzin kol mamonam vetappam. veen horgin ishsha velo katan shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20, 14)</small> "vehannashim vehattaf" ze taf shel zecharim. bamme devarim amurim bemilchemet harshut shehu im shear haummot. aval shiva amamin vaamalek shello hishlimu en mannichin mehem neshama shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20, 15)</small> "ken taase lechol" vegomer <small>(Devarim 20, 16)</small> "rak meare haammim" <small>(Devarim 20, 16)</small> "lo techayye kol neshama". vechen hu omer baamalek <small>(Devarim 25, 19)</small> "timche et zecher amalek". uminnayin sheeno medabber ella beellu shello hishlimu shenneemar <small>(Yehoshua 11, 19)</small> "lo hayta ir asher hishlima el bene yisrael bilti hachivvi yshve givon et hakkol lakchu vammilchama" <small>(Yehoshua 11, 20)</small> "ki meet Adonai hayta lechazzek et libbam likrat hammilchama et yisrael lemaan hacharimam". michlal sheshshalchu lahem leshalom velo kibbelu:

Shelosha ketavim shalach yehoshua ad shello nichnas laaretz. harishon shalach lahem mi sherotze livroach yivrach. vechazar veshalach mi sherotze lehashelim yashlim. vechazar veshalach mi sherotze laasot milchama yaase. im ken mippene ma heerimu yoshve givon. lefi sheshshalach lahem bakkelal velo kibbelu. velo yadu mishpat yisrael vedimmu sheshshuv en potchin lahem leshalom. velamma kasha haddavar lannesiim verau sherauy lehakkotam lefi cherev lule hashshevua. mippene shekkartu lahem berit vahare hu omer <small>(Devarim 7, 2)</small> "lo tichrot lahem berit" ella haya dinam sheyyihyu lemas avadim. vehoil uvetaut nishbeu lahen bedin haya sheyyehargu al shehitum lule chillul hashshem:

Ammon umoav en sholchin lahem leshalom shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23, 7)</small> "lo tidrosh shelomam vetovatam kol yamecha". amru chachamim lefi shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20, 10)</small> "vekarata eleha leshalom" yachol ammon umoav ken. talmud lomar lo tidrosh shelomam vetovatam. lefi shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23, 17)</small> "immecha yeshev bekirbecha" <small>(Devarim 23, 17)</small> "battov lo lo tonennu". yachol ammon umoav ken talmud lomar vetovatam. veaf al pi sheen shoalim bishlomam im hishlimu meatzmam techilla mekabbelin otan:

Keshetztzarin al ir letafsah. en makkifin otah mearba ruchoteha ella mishshalosh ruchoteha. umannichin makom labboreach ulechol mi sheyyirtze lehimmalet al nafsho. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar lo, 7)</small> "vayyitzbeu al midyan kaasher tzivva Adonai et mshe". mippi hashshemua lamdu shebbechach tzivvahu:

En kotztzin ilane maachol shechutz lammedina veen monin mehem ammat hammayim kede sheyyivshu. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20, 19)</small> "lo tashchit et etzah". vechol hakkotzetz loke. velo bematzor bilvad ella bechol makom kol hakkotzetz ilan maachol derech hashechata loke. aval kotztzin oto im haya mazzik ilanot acherim. o mippene shemmazzik bisde acherim. o mippene sheddamav yekarim. lo asra tora ella derech hashechata:

Kol ilan serak muttar lakotz oto vaafillu eno tzarich lo. vechen ilan maachol shehizkin veeno ose ella davar muat sheeno rauy litroach bo muttar lakotz oto. vechamma yehe hazzayit ose velo yekutztzennu. rova hakkav zetim. vedekel shehu ose kav temarim lo yekutztzennu:
Velo hailanot bilvad. ella kol hameshabber kelim. vekorea begadim. vehores binyan. vesotem mayan. umeabbed maachalot derech hashechata. over belo tashchit. veeno loke ella makkat mardut middivrehem:

Tzarin al ayarot shel akkum shelosha yamim kodem hashshabbat veosin immahem milchama bechol yom veyom vaafillu beshabbat. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20, 20)</small> "ad ridtah" vaafillu beshabbat. ben milchemet mitzva ben milchemet reshut:
Keshechonin chonin bechol makom. umi shenneherag bammilchama bammakom sheyyippol sham yikkaver. kone mekomo kemet mitzva:

Arbaa devarim patru bammachane. ochlim haddemay. ufeturim merchitzat yadayim battechilla. umeviin etzim mikkol makom. vaafillu metzaan telushim viveshim en makpidin al kach bammachane. vechen peturin millearev eruve chatzerot bammachane ella metaltelin meohel leohel umissukka lesukka vehu sheyyakkifu kol hammachane mechitztza gevoha asara tefachim kede shettihye reshut yachid kemo shennitbaer behilchot shabbat. veen mechitztza pechuta measara. ucheshem sheppeturin mikkol ellu bahalichatan kach peturin bachaziratan:

Veasur lehippanot betoch hammachane o al pene hassade bechol makom. ella mitzvat ase letakken sham derech meyuchedet lehippanot bah. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23, 13)</small> "veyad tihye lecha michutz lammachane":

Vechen mitzvat ase lihyot yated lechol echad veechad teluya im kele milchamto. veyetze beotah hadderech veyachpor bah veyippane vichasse. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23, 14)</small> "veyated tihye lecha al azenecha" vegomer. uven sheyyesh immahen aron uven sheen immahen aron kach hem osim tamid. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23, 15)</small> "vehaya machanecha kadosh":
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 7: Echad milchemet mitzva veechad milchemet harshut memannin kohen ledabber el haam bishat hammilchama. umoshchin oto beshemen hammishcha vezehu hannikra meshuach milchama:

Shete peamim medabber meshuach milchama el haam. achat bassefar beet sheyyotzin kodem sheyyaarchu hammilchama. omer laam <small>(Devarim 20, 6)</small> "mi haish asher nata kerem velo chillelo" vegomer. kesheyyishma devarav yachzor meorche hammilchama. veachat beorche hammilchama omer <small>(Devarim 20, 3)</small> "al tiru veal tachpezu":

Et sheorchin hammaarachot vehem kerevim lehillachem. meshuach milchama omed bemakom gavoah vechol hammaarachot lefanav. veomer lahem bilshon hakkodesh <small>(Devarim 20, 3)</small> "shema yisrael attem kerevim hayyom lammilchama al oyvechem". <small>(Devarim 20, 3)</small> "al yerach levavchem al tiru veal tachpezu veal taartzu mippenehem". <small>(Devarim 20, 4)</small> "ki Adonai elohechem hahlech immachem lehillachem lachem im oyvechem lehoshia etchem". ad kan omer meshuach milchama vechohen acher tachtav mashmia oto lechol haam bekol ram. veachar kach medabber meshuach milchama <small>(Devarim 20, 5)</small> "mi haish asher bana vayit chadash" vegomer <small>(Devarim 20, 6)</small> "umi haish asher nata kerem" vegomer <small>(Devarim 20, 7)</small> "umi haish asher eras" vegomer. ad kan meshuach milchama medabber vehashshoter mashmia lechol haam bekol ram. veachar kach medabber hashshoter meatzmo veomer <small>(Devarim 20, 8)</small> "mi haish hayyare verach hallevav" veshoter acher mashmia lechol haam:

Veachar shechozrin kol hachozrin meorche hammilchama. metakkenin et hammaarachot. ufokdim sare tzevaot berosh haam. umaamidin meachor kol maaracha umaaracha shotrim chazakim veazzim. vechashshilin shel barzel bidehem. harotze lachzor min hammilchama harshut beyadan lachtoch et shoko. shettechillat nefila nisa. bamme devarim amurim shemmachzirin anashim ellu meorche hammilchama bemilchemet harshut. aval bemilchemet mitzva hakkol yotzin vaafillu chatan mechadro vechalla mechuppatah:

Echad habbone bayit lishivato. veechad habbone bet habbakar. bet haetzim. bet haotzarot. hoil verauy ledira. veechad habbone. veechad hallokeach. veechad shennittan lo bemattana o hayyoresh. hare ze chozer. aval habbone [bet hatteven] uvet shaar. achsadra umirpeset. o bayit sheen bo arba ammot al arba ammot. o haggozel bayit. hare ze eno chozer:

Echad hannotea kerem. veechad hannotea chamishsha ilane maachol. vaafillu mechameshet mine maachol. echad hannotea. veechad hammavrich veechad hammarkiv haveracha veharekava shehi chayyevet bearla. echad hallokeach. veechad hayyoresh. veechad shennittan lo bemattana. aval hannotea arbaa ilane maachol. o chamishsha ilane serak. o sheggazal kerem. eno chozer alav. vechen kerem shel shene shuttafin en chozrin alav:

Echad hameares et habbetula. veechad hameares et haalmana. vechen im nafla lo yevama afillu chamishsha achim umet echad mehen kullan chozrin. kiddesh ishsha meachshav uleachar shenem asar chodesh veshalam hazzeman bammilchama chozer uva lo:
Hammachazir et gerushato. vehameares ishsha haasura alav. kegon almana lechohen gadol. gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot. mamzeret unetina leyisrael. bat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin. eno chozer:
Kol ellu shechozrin meorche hammilchama. kesheshshomin et divre hakkohen chozrin. umesappekin mayim umazon laachehem shebbatztzava. umetakkenin et hadderachim:

Veellu sheen yotzin leorche hammilchama kol ikkar. veen matrichin otam leshum davar baolam. habbone bayit vachanacho. vehannose arusato o sheyyibbem. umi shechillel karmo. en yotzin ad tom shana. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24, 5)</small> "naki yihye leveto shana echat vesimmach et ishto asher lakach". mippi hakkabbala lamdu sheyyihye naki shana ben labbayit shekkana ben laishsha shennasa ben lakkerem shehitchil leechol piryo:

Kol hashshana en mesappek mayim umazon. velo metakken derech. velo shomer bachoma. velo noten lefasse hair. velo yaavor alav shum davar baolam. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24, 5)</small> "lo yetze batztzava velo yaavor alav lechol davar" laavor bishne lavin. lo letzarche hair velo letzarche haggedud:
Bana bayit vehiskiro laacherim vehikdim lo secharo hare ze kemi shechanacho. natan lo secharo leachar shenem asar chodesh hare hu kemi shello chanacho ad atta:
Bana bayit venatan bo chafatzav venaal alehem. im haya tzarich levattel al shemiratan hare ze kemi shechanacho vehitchil leshev bo. veim enan tzerichin leshev uleshamran hare ze kemi shello chanacho:
Vechol habbone bayit o notea kerem bechutza laaretz eno chozer alehen:

<small>(Devarim 20, 8)</small> "mi haish hayyare verach hallevav" kemashmao. sheen belibbo koach laamod bekishre hammilchama. umeachar sheyyikkanes bekishre hammilchama yishshaen al mikve yisrael umoshio beet tzara veyeda sheal yichud hashshem hu ose milchama veyasim nafsho bechappo velo yira velo yifchad velo yachshov lo beishto velo bevanav ella yimche zichronam millibbo veyippane mikkol davar lammilchama. vechol hammatchil lachshov uleharher bammilchama umavhil atzmo over belo taase. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20, 3)</small> "al yerach levavchem al tiru veal tachpezu veal taartzu mippenehem". velo od ella shekkol deme yisrael teluyin betzavvaro. veim lo nitztzeach velo asa milchama bechol libbo uvechol nafsho. hare ze kemi sheshshafach deme hakkol. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 20, 8)</small> "velo yimmas et levav echav kilvavo". vahare meforash bakkabbala <small>(yirmeya moach, 10)</small> "arur osho melechet Adonai remiyya" vearur monea charbo middam. vechol hannilcham bechol libbo belo pachad vetihye kavvanato lekaddesh et hashshem bilvad. muvtach lo shello yimtza nezek velo taggiehu raa. veyivne lo bayit nachon beyisrael veyizke lo ulevanav ad olam veyizke lechayye haolam habba. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 1 25, 28)</small> "ki aso yaase Adonai ladoni bayit neeman ki milchamot Adonai adoni nilcham veraa lo timmatze vecha" vegomer <small>(Shmuel 1 25, 29)</small> "vehayta nefesh adoni tzerura bitzror hachayyim et Adonai elohecha":
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 8: Chalutze tzava kesheyyikkansu bigvul haakkum veyichbeshum veyishbu mehen. muttar lahen leechol nevelot uterefot uvesar chazir vechayyotze bo im yirav velo matza ma yochal ella maachalot ellu haasurim. vechen shote yen nesech. mippi hashshemua lamdu uvattim meleim kol tuv arpe chazirim vechayyotze bahen:

Vechen boel ishsha begeutah im tekafo yitzro. aval lo yivalenna veyelech lo. ella machnisah letoch beto. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21, 11)</small> "veraita bashshivya eshet yefat toar". veasur livol otah bia sheniyya ad sheyyissaenna:

En eshet yefat toar mutteret ella bishat hashshivya. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21, 11)</small> "veraita bashshivya". ben betula ben beula ben eshet ish. sheen ishut leakkum. vechashakta af al pi sheenah yafa. vah velo bachavertah shello yivol shetayim. velakachta lecha leishsha shello yikkach shetayim veyivol achat veyanniach achat leaviv o leachiv. uminnayin shello yilchatzenna bammilchama. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21, 12)</small> "vahavetah el toch betecha". yachnisah lemakom veachar kach yivol:
Hakkohen muttar bifat toar bevia rishona. shello dibbera tora ella keneged hayyetzer. aval eno yachol lissaenna achar kach mippene shehi giyyoret:

Vechetzad din yisrael bifat toar. achare sheyyivalenna bia rishona vehi begeutah im kibbela aleha lehikkanes tachat kanfe hashshechina matbilah leshem gerut miyyad. veim lo kibbela teshev beveto sheloshim yom. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21, 13)</small> "uvachta et aviha veet immah yerach yamim". vechen bocha al datah veeno monah. umegaddelet et tzipparneha. umegallachat et roshah kede shettitganne beenav. vetihye immo babbayit. nichnas veroe otah. yotze veroe otah. kede sheyyakutz bah. umegalgel immah kede shettekabbel. im kibbela veratza bah. hare zo mitgayyeret vetovelet kechol haggerim:

Utzericha lehametin shelosha chodashim. chodesh shel bechiyya ushene chodashim acharav. venosah bichtubba vekiddushin. im lo chafetz bah meshallechah lenafshah. veim mecharah over belo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21, 14)</small> "umachor lo timkerenna bakkasef". [veim mecharah] enah mechura umachazir haddamim. vechen im kevashah achar shennivala leshem shifcha mishsheyyishtammesh bah over belo taase. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 21, 14)</small> "lo titammer bah" shello yishtammesh bah:

Lo ratzta lehitgayyer megalgelin immah shenem asar chodesh. lo ratzta mekabbelet sheva mitzvot shennitztauu bene noach umeshallechah lenafshah. vahare hi kechol haggerim hattoshavim. veeno nosah sheasur lissa ishsha shello nitgayyera:

Nitabbera mibbia rishona hare havvalad ger. veeno beno ledavar min haddevarim mippene shehu min haakkum. ella bet din matbilin oto al datam. vetamar mibbia rishona shel yefat toar hayta. aval avshalom nolad meachar hannissuin. nimtzet tamar achot avshalom meimmo umutteret lehinnase leamnon. vechen hu omer <small>(Shmuel 2 13, 13)</small> "dabber na el hammelech ki lo yimnaeni mimmekka":

Yefat toar shello ratzta lehaniach avoda zara achar hashshenem asar chodesh. horgin otah. vechen ir shehishlima en kortin lahen berit ad sheyyichperu baavoda zara viabbedu et kol mekomoteha vikabbelu shear hammitzvot shennitztauu bene noach. shekkol akkum shello kibbel mitzvot shennitztauu bene noach horgin oto im yeshno tachat yadenu:

Moshe rabbenu lo hinchil hattora vehammitzvot ella leyisrael. shenneemar <small>(Devarim 33, 4)</small> "morasha kehillat yaakov". ulechol harotze lehitgayyer mishshear haummot. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15, 15)</small> "kachem kagger". aval mi shello ratza en kofin oto lekabbel tora umitzvot. vechen tzivva moshe rabbenu mippi haggevura lachof et kol bae haolam lekabbel mitzvot shennitztauu bene noach. vechol mi shello yekabbel yehareg. vehamekabbel otam hu hannikra ger toshav bechol makom. vetzarich lekabbel alav bifne shelosha chaverim. vechol hamekabbel alav lamul veavru alav shenem asar chodesh velo mal hare ze kemin haummot:

Kol hamekabbel sheva mitzvot venizhar laasotan hare ze mechaside ummot haolam. veyesh lo chelek laolam habba. vehu sheyyekabbel otan veyaase otan mippene shetztzivva bahen hakkadosh baruch hu battora vehodianu al yede moshe rabbenu shebbene noach mikkodem nitztauu bahen. aval im asaan mippene hechrea haddaat en ze ger toshav veeno mechaside ummot haolam velo mechachmehem:
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 9: Al shishsha devarim nitztavva adam harishon. al avoda zara. veal birkat hashshem. veal shefichut damim. veal gilluy arayot. veal haggezel. veal haddinim. af al pi shekkullan hen kabbala beyadenu mimmoshe rabbenu. vehaddaat nota lahen. mikkelal divre tora yerae sheal ellu nitztavva. hosif lenoach ever min hachay shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 9, 4)</small> "ach basar benafsho damo lo tochelu". nimtzeu sheva mitzvot. vechen haya haddavar bechol haolam ad avraham. ba avraham venitztavva yeter al ellu bemila. vehu hitpallel shacharit. veyyitzchak hifrish maaser vehosif tefilla acheret lifnot hayyom. veyaakov hosif gid hannashe vehitpallel arvit. uvemitzrayim nitztavva amram bemitzvot yeterot. ad shebba moshe rabbenu venishlema tora al yado:

Ben noach sheavad avoda zara hare ze chayyav. vehu sheyyaavod kedarkah. vechol avoda zara shebbet din shel yisrael memitin aleha ben noach neherag aleha. vechol sheen bet din shel yisrael memitin aleha en ben noach neherag aleha. veaf al pi sheeno neherag asur bakkol. veen menichin oto lehakim matztzeva. velo litta ashera. velo laasot tzurot vechayyotze bahen lenoy:
Ben noach shebberech et hashshem. ben shebberech bashshem hameyuchad. ben shebberech bechinnuy bechol lashon chayyav. ma sheen ken beyisrael:

Ben noach sheharag nefesh afillu ebbar bime immo neherag alav. vechen im harag terefa o shekkefato unetano lifne ari o shehinnicho baraav ad shemmet. hoil vehemit mikkol makom neherag. vechen im harag rodef sheyyachol lehatztzilo beechad meevarav neherag alav. ma sheen ken beyisrael:

Shesh arayot asurot al bene noach. haem. veeshet haav. veeshet ish. vaachoto meimmo. vezachur. uvehema. shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 2, 24)</small> "al ken yaazav ish et aviv" zo eshet aviv. <small>(Bereshit 2, 24)</small> "veet immo" kemashmaah. <small>(Bereshit 2, 24)</small> "vedavak beishto" velo beeshet chavero. beishto velo bezachur. <small>(Bereshit 2, 24)</small> "vehayu levasar echad" lehotzi behema chayya veof sheen hu vehem basar echad. veneemar <small>(Bereshit 20, 12)</small> "achoti vat avi hi ach lo vat immi vattehi li leishsha":

Ben noach chayyav al mefuttat aviv vaanusat aviv hare hi immo mikkol makom. vechayyav al eshet aviv afillu leachar mitat aviv. vechayyav al hazzachur ben katan ben gadol veal habbehema ben ketanna ben gedola. vehu neherag levaddo veen horgin et habbehema. shello nitztauu baharigat behema ella yisrael:

En ben noach chayyav al eshet chavero ad sheyyavo aleha kedarkah achar shennivala levalah. aval meorasa o shennichnesa lechuppa velo nivala en chayyavin aleha. shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 20, 3)</small> "vehi beulat baal". bamme devarim amurim beven noach shebba al bat noach. aval akkum habba al hayyisreelit ben kedarkah ben shello kedarkah chayyav. veim hayta naara meorasa niskal aleha kedine yisrael. ba aleha achar shennichnesa lachuppa velo nivala hare ze bechenek kedine yisrael. aval im ba al eshet yisrael achar shennivala hare ze kemi shebba al eshet akkum chavero veyehareg besayif:

Ben noach sheyyiched shifcha leavdo uva aleha hare ze neherag aleha mishshum eshet chavero. veeno chayyav aleha ad sheyyifshot haddavar veyomru lah haam zo devet eved peloni. umeematay tachzor lehetterah mishsheyyafrishenna meavdo veyifra roshah bashshuk. umeematay tihye eshet chavero kigrusha shellanu mishsheyyotzienna mibbeto vishallechenna leatzmah. o mishshettetze hi mittachat reshuto vattelech lah. sheen lahem gerushin bichtav. veen haddavar taluyi bo levad. ella kol zeman sheyyirtze hu o hi lifrosh ze mizze porshin:

Ben noach chayyav al haggezel. ben sheggazal akkum ben sheggazal yisrael. veechad haggozel o haggonev mamon o gonev nefesh o hakkovesh sechar sachir vechayyotze bo. afillu poel sheachal shello bishat melacha. al hakkol hu chayyav vahare hu bichlal gazlan. ma sheen ken beyisrael. vechen chayyav al pachot mishsheve peruta. uven noach sheggazal pachot mishsheve peruta uva acher ugezalah mimmennu. shenehen neheragin aleha:
Vechen chayyav al ever min hachay veal basar min hachay bechol shehu. shello nittenu hashshiurin ella leyisrael bilvad. umuttar hu bedam min hachay:
Echad haever o habbasar happoresh min habbehema o min hachayya. aval haof yerae li sheen ben noach neherag al ever min hachay mimmennu:
Hashshochet et habbehema afillu shachat bah shene hassimanin. kol zeman shehi mefarkeset ever uvasar happorshin mimmenna asurin livne noach mishshum ever min hachay:

Kol sheasur al yisrael mishshum ever min hachay asur al bene noach. veyesh shebbene noach chayyavin velo yisrael. shebbene noach echad behema vechayya ben temea ben tehora chayyavin aleha mishshum ever min hachay. umishshum basar min hachay. veever uvasar happorshin min hamefarkeset af al pi sheshshachat bah yisrael shene simanin hare ze asur livne noach mishshum ever min hachay:

Vechetzad metzuvvin hen al haddinin. chayyavin lehoshiv dayyanin veshoftim bechol pelech ufelech ladun beshesh mitzvot ellu. ulehazhir et haam. uven noach sheavar al achat mishsheva mitzvot ellu yehareg besayif. umippene ze nitchayyevu kol baale shechem hariga. shehare shechem gazal vehem rau veyadu velo danuhu. uven noach neherag beed echad uvedayyan echad belo hateraa veal pi kerovin. aval lo beedut ishsha. velo tadun ishsha lahem:
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 10: Ben noach sheshshagag beachat mimmitzvotav patur mikkelum. chutz merotzeach bishgaga sheim harago goel haddam eno neherag alav. veen lo ir miklat. aval batte dinehen en memitin oto. bamme devarim amurim beshagag beachat mimmitzvot veavar belo kavvana. kegon shebbaal eshet chavero vedimma shehi ishto o penuya. aval im yada shehi eshet chavero velo yada shehi asura alav. ella ala al libbo sheddavar ze muttar lo. vechen im harag vehu lo yada sheasur laharog. hare ze karov lemezid veneherag. velo techashev zo lahem shegaga mippene shehaya lo lilmod velo lamad:

Ben noach sheanaso annas laavor al achat mimmitzvotav. muttar lo laavor. afillu neenas laavod avoda zara oved. lefi sheenan metzuvvin al kiddush hashshem. uleolam en onshin mehen lo katan velo cheresh velo shote lefi sheenan bene mitzvot:

Ben noach shennitgayyer umal vetaval veachar kach ratza lachzor meachare Adonai velihyot ger toshav bilvad keshehaya mikkodem. en shomin lo. ella yihye keyisrael lechol davar o yehareg. veim haya katan keshehitbiluhu bet din. yachol limchot beshaa sheyyagdil veyihye ger toshav bilvad. vechevan shello micha bishato shuv eno moche ella hare hu ger tzedek. lefichach im ba yisrael al ketanna shehitbiluha bet din. kesef ketubbatah o kenas ones o mefatte yihye hakkol tachat yad bet din ad shettagdil velo timche baggerut. shemma tittol vetagdil vetimche venimtzet zo ochelet begeutah maot sheen lah zechut bahen ella bedine yisrael:

Ben noach shebberech et hashshem o sheavad avoda zara o shebba al eshet chavero o sheharag chavero venitgayyer. patur. harag ben yisrael o shebba al eshet yisrael venitgayyer chayyav vehorgin oto al ben yisrael. vechonkin oto al eshet yisrael shebbaal shehare nishtanna dino:
Kevar bearnu shekkol mitat bene noach besayif. ella im baal eshet yisrael o naara meorasa yissakel. veim bealah achar shennichnesa lachuppa kodem shettibbael yechanek:
Mippi hakkabbala shebbene noach asurin beharebaat behema uveharkavat ilan bilvad. veen neheragin alehen. veakkum shehikka yisrael afillu chaval bo kol shehu af al pi shehu chayyav mita eno neherag:

Hammila nitztavva bah avraham vezaro bilvad. shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 17, 9)</small> "atta vezaracha acharecha". yatza zaro shel yishmael shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 21, 12)</small> "ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara". veyatza esav shehare yitzchak amar leyaakov <small>(Bereshit 28, 4)</small> "veyitten lecha et birkat avraham lecha ulezaracha". michlal shehu levaddo zaro shel avraham hammachazik bedato uvedarko hayeshara. vehem hamechuyyavin bemila:

Amru chachamim shebbene ketura shehem zaro shel avraham shebba achar yishmael veyitzchak chayyavin bemila. vehoil venitarvu hayyom bene yishmael bivne ketura yitchayyevu hakkol bemila bashshemini. veen neheragin aleha:

Akkum sheasak battora chayyav mita. lo yaasok ella besheva mitzvot shellahen bilvad. vechen akkum sheshshavat afillu beyom mimot hachol im asaahu leatzmo kemo shabbat chayyav mita. veen tzarich lomar im asa moed leatzmo. kelalo shel davar en menichin otan lechaddesh dat velaasot mitzvot leatzman middatan. ella o yihye ger tzedek vikabbel kol hammitzvot. o yaamod betorato velo yosif velo yigra. veim asak battora o shavat o chiddesh davar. makkin oto veonshin oto umodiin oto shehu chayyav mita al ze. aval eno neherag:

Ben noach sheratza laasot mitzva mishshear mitzvot hattora kede lekabbel sachar. en monin oto laasotah kehilchatah. veim hevi ola mekabbelin mimmennu. natan tzedaka mekabbelin mimmennu. veyerae li shennotnin otah laaniyye yisrael. hoil vehu nizzon miyyisrael umitzva alehem lehacheyoto. aval haakkum shennatan tzedaka mekabbelin mimmennu venotnin otah laaniyye akkum:

Chayyavin bet din shel yisrael laasot shoftim leellu haggerim hattoshavim ladun lahen al pi mishpatim ellu. kede shello yishshachet haolam. im rau bet din sheyyaamidu shoftehem mehen maamidin. veim rau sheyyaamidu lahen miyyisrael maamidin:

Shene akkum shebbau lefanecha ladun bedine yisrael veratzu shenehen ladun din tora danin. haechad rotze vehaechad eno rotze en kofin oto ladun ella bedinehen. haya yisrael veakkum im yesh zechut leyisrael bedinehen danin lo bedinehem. veomrim lo kach dinechem. veim yesh zechut leyisrael bedinenu danin lo din tora veomrim lo kach dinenu. veyerae li sheen osin ken leger toshav ella leolam danin lo bedinehem. vechen yerae li shennohagin im gere toshav bederech eretz ugemilut chasadim keyisrael. shehare anu metzuvvin lehachayotan shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14, 21)</small> "lagger asher bisharecha tittenenna vaachalah". veze sheamru chachamim en koflin lahen shalom beakkum lo beger toshav. afillu haakkum tziuu chachamim levakker cholehem velikbor metehem im mete yisrael ulefarnes aniyyehem bichlal aniyye yisrael mippene darche shalom. hare neemar <small>(Tehillim 145, 9)</small> "tov Adonai lakkol verachamav al kol maasav". veneemar <small>(Mishlei 3, 17)</small> "deracheha darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom":
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 11: Hammelech hammashiach atid laamod ulehachzir malochut david leyashnah lammemshala harishona. uvone hammikdash umekabbetz nidche yisrael. vechozrin kol hammishpatim beyamav keshehayu mikkodem. makrivin karbanot. veosin shemittin veyovlot kechol mitzvatan haamura battora. vechol mi sheeno maamin bo. o mi sheeno mechakke leviato. lo bishar neviim bilvad hu kofer. ella battora uvemoshe rabbenu. shehare hattora heida alav shenneemar <small>(Devarim 30, 3)</small> "veshav Adonai elohecha et shevutecha verichamecha veshav vekibbetzcha" vegomer <small>(Devarim 30, 4)</small> "im yihye niddachacha biktze hashshamayim" vegomer <small>(Devarim 30, 5)</small> "veheviacha Adonai". veellu haddevarim hameforashim battora hem kollim kol haddevarim shenneemru al yede kol hanneviim. af befarashat bilam neemar vesham nibbe bishne hammeshichim. bammashiach harishon shehu david shehoshia et yisrael miyyad tzarehem. uvammashiach haacharon sheomed mibbanav shemmoshia et yisrael [baacharona]. vesham hu omer <small>(Bamidbar 24, 17)</small> "erennu velo atta" ze david. <small>(Bamidbar 24, 17)</small> "ashurennu velo karov" ze melech hammashiach. <small>(Bamidbar 24, 17)</small> "darach kochav miyyaakov" ze david. <small>(Bamidbar 24, 17)</small> "vekam shevet miyyisrael" ze melech hammashiach. <small>(Bamidbar 24, 17)</small> "umachatz paate moav" ze david. vechen hu omer <small>(Shmuel 2 8, 2)</small> "vayyach et moav vaymaddedem bachevel" <small>(Bamidbar 24, 17)</small> "vekarkar kol bene shet" ze hammelech hammashiach shenneemar bo <small>(Zecharya 9, 10)</small> "umashlo miyyam ad yam". <small>(Bamidbar 24, 18)</small> "vehaya edom yeresha" ze david. shenneemar <small>(Shmuel 2 8, 14)</small> "vattehi edom ledavid laavadim" vegomer. <small>(Bamidbar 24, 18)</small> "vehaya yeresha" vegomer ze hammelech hammashiach shenneemar <small>(Ovadya 1, 21)</small> "vealu moshiim behar tziyyon" vegomer:

Af beare miklat hu omer <small>(Devarim 19, 8)</small> "im yarchiv Adonai elohecha et gevulcha" <small>(Devarim 19, 9)</small> "veyasafta lecha od shalosh arim" vegomer. umeolam lo haya davar ze. velo tzivva hakkadosh baruch hu letohu. aval bedivre hanneviim en haddavar tzarich reaya shekkol hassefarim meleim bedavar ze:

Veal yaale al datecha shehammelech hammashiach tzarich laasot otot umoftim umechaddesh devarim baolam o mechayye metim vechayyotze bidvarim ellu [2.] en haddavar kach. shehare rabbi akiva chacham gadol mechachme mishna haya. vehu haya nose kelav shel ben koziva hammelech. vehu haya omer alav shehu hammelech hammashiach. vedimma hu vechol chachme doro shehu hammelech hammashiach. ad shenneherag baavonot. kevan shenneherag noda lahem sheeno. velo shaalu mimmennu chachamim lo ot velo mofet. veikkar haddevarim kacha hen. shehattora hazzot chukkeha umishpateha leolam uleolme olamim. veen mosifin alehen velo gorin mehen:
