Veim yaamod melech mibbet david hoge battora veosek bemitzvot kedavid aviv. kefi tora shebbichtav veshebbeal pe. veyachof kol yisrael lelech bah ulechazzek bidkah. veyillachem milchamot Adonai. hare ze bechezkat shehu mashiach. (im asa vehitzliach uvana mikdash bimkomo vekibbetz nidche yisrael hare ze mashiach bevadday. vitakken et haolam kullo laavod et Adonai beyachad shenneemar ki az ehpoch el ammim safa verura likro chullam beshem Adonai uleavdo shechem echad):

Veim lo hitzliach ad ko, o neherag, beyadua sheeno ze shehivticha alav tora, vahare hu kechol malche bet david hashshelemim hakkesherim shemmetu. velo heemido hakkadosh baruch hu ella lenassot bo rabbim, shenneemar "umin hammaskilim yikkashlu litzrof bahen ulevarer velalben ad et ketz ki od lammoed".

Af yeshua hannotzri sheddima sheyyihye mashiach, veneherag bevet din, kevar nitnabbe bo daniyyel, shenneemar "uvene paritze ammecha yinnasseu lehaamid chazon venichshalu" (Daniel 11, 14). vechi yesh michshol gadol mizze, shekkol hanneviim dibberu shehammashiach goel yisrael umoshiam, umekabbetz nidchehem umechazzek mitzvatan, veze garam leabbed yisrael bacherev, ulefazzer sheeritam ulehashpilam, ulehachalif hattora, ulehatot rov haolam laavod eloah mibbalade Adonai.

Aval machshevot bore olam en koach baadam lehassigam, ki lo derachenu derachav velo machshevotenu machshevotav. vechol haddevarim haellu shel yeshua hannotzri, veshel ze hayyishmeeli sheamad acharav, enan ella leyashsher derech lammelech hammashiach, uletakken et haolam kullu laavod et Adonai beyachad: shenneemar "ki az ehpoch el ammim safa verura likro kullam beshem Adonai uleovdo shechem echad" (raa Tzefanya 3, 9).

Ketzad: kevar nitmalle haolam kullo middivre hammashiach, umiddivre hattora umiddivre hammitzvot, ufashtu devarim ellu beiyyim rechokim, uveammim rabbim arle lev; vehem nosim venotnim bidvarim ellu uvemitzvot hattora, ellu omrim mitzvot ellu emet hayu, uchevar batlu bazzeman hazze, velo hayu nohagot ledorot. veellu omrim devarim nistarot yesh bahem, veenan kifshutan, uchevar ba mashiach, vegilla nisterehem.
Uchesheyyaamod hammelech hammashiach beemet, veyatzliach veyarum veyinase, miyyad hem kulan chozrin veyodim sheshsheker nachalu avotehem, veshenneviehem vaavotehem hitum.
Mishneh Torah, Kings and Wars 12: Al yaale al hallev shebbimot hammashiach yibbatel davar mimminhago shel olam. o yihye sham chiddush bemaase bereshit. ella olam keminhago noheg. veze shenneemar bishaya <small>(yeshaya 11, 6)</small> "vegar zeev im keves venamer im gedi yirbatz" mashal vechida. inyan haddavar sheyyihyu yisrael yoshvin lavetach im rishe akkum hameshulim kizev venamer. shenneemar <small>(yirmeya 5, 6)</small> "zeev aravot yeshaddem venamer shoked al arehem". veyachzeru kullam ledat haemet. velo yigzelu velo yashchitu. ella yochlu davar hammuttar benachat im yisrael. shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 11, 7)</small> "vearye kabbakar yochal teven". vechen kol kayyotze beellu haddevarim beinyan hammashiach hem meshalim. uvimot hammelech hammashiach yivvada lakkol lee ze davar haya mashal. uma inyan ramzu bahen:

Amru chachamim en ben haolam hazze limot hammashiach ella shibud malchuyyot bilvad. yerae mippeshutan shel divre hanneviim. shebbitchillat yemot hammashiach tihye milchemet gog umagog. veshekkodem milchemet gog umagog yaamod navi leyashsher yisrael ulehachin libbam. shenneemar <small>(Malachi 3, 23)</small> "hinne anochi sholeach lachem et eliyya" vegomer. veeno ba lo letamme hattahor. velo letaher hattame. velo lifsol anashim shehem bechezkat kashrut. velo lehacheshir mi shehuchzeku pesulin. ella lasum shalom baolam. shenneemar <small>(Malachi 3, 24)</small> "veheshiv lev avot al banim". veyesh min hachachamim sheomrim shekkodem biat hammashiach yavo eliyyahu. vechol ellu haddevarim vechayyotze bahen lo yeda adam ech yihyu ad sheyyihyu. sheddevarim setumin hen etzel hanneviim. gam hachachamim en lahem kabbala bidvarim ellu. ella lefi hechrea happesukim. ulefichach yesh lahem machloket bidvarim ellu. veal kol panim en siddur havayat devarim ellu velo dikdukehen ikkar baddat. uleolam lo yitassek adam bedivre hahaggadot. velo yaarich bammidrashot haamurim beinyanim ellu vechayyotze bahen. velo yesimem ikkar. sheen meviin lo lide yira velo lide ahava. vechen lo yechashshev hakkitztzin. amru chachamim tippach rucham shel mechashsheve hakkitztzim. ella yechakke veyaamin bichlal haddavar kemo shebbearnu:

Bime hammelech hammashiach. keshettityashshev mamlachto veyitkabbetzu elav kol yisrael. yityachasu kullam al piv beruach hakkodesh shettanuach alav. shenneemar <small>(Malachi 3, 3)</small> "veyashav metzaref umetaher" vegomer. uvene levi metaher techilla veomer ze meyuchas kohen veze meyuchas levi. vedoche et sheenan meyuchasin leyisrael. hare hu omer <small>(Ezra 2, 63)</small> "vayyomer hattirshata lahem" vegomer <small>(Ezra 2, 63)</small> "ad amod kohen leurim uletummim". hinne lamadta shebberuach hakkodesh meyachasin hammuchzakin umodiin hameyuchas. veeno meyaches yisrael ella leshivtehem. shemmodia shezze mishshevet peloni veze mishshevet peloni. aval eno omer al shehen bechezkat kashrut ze mamzer veze eved. shehaddin hu shemmishpacha shennitmea nitmea:

Lo nitauu hachachamim vehanneviim yemot hammashiach. lo kede sheyyishletu al kol haolam. velo kede sheyyirdu baakkum. velo kede sheyyenasseu otam haammim. velo kede leechol velishtot velismoach. ella kede sheyyihyu penuyin battora vechachmatah. velo yihye lahem noges umevattel. kede sheyyizku lechayye haolam habba. kemo shebbearnu behilchot teshuva:

Uveoto hazzeman lo yihye sham lo raav velo milchama. velo kina vetacharut. shehattova tihye mushpaat harebe. vechol hammaadannim metzuyin keafar. velo yihye esek kol haolam ella ladaat et Adonai bilvad. ulefichach yihyu yisrael chachamim gedolim veyodim devarim hassetumim veyassigu daat boram kefi koach haadam. shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 11, 9)</small> "ki mala haaretz dea et Adonai kammayim layyam mechassim":
Mishneh Torah, Leavened and Unleavened B:
Kol haochel kezayit chametz befesach mittechillat lel chamishsha asar ad sof yom echad veesrim benisan bemezid chayyav karet shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 15)</small> "ki kol ochel chametz venichreta". beshogeg chayyav karban chattat kevua. echad haochel veechad hamemache veshote: 
Hechametz bappesach asur bahanaya shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 3)</small> "lo yeachel chametz" lo yehe bo hetter achila. vehammanniach chametz birshuto befesach af al pi shello achalo over bishne lavin shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 7)</small> <small>(Devarim 16 4)</small> "lo yerae lecha seor bechol gevulecha" veneemar <small>(Shemot 12 19)</small> "seor lo yimmatze bevattechem". veissur hechametz veissur hasseor shebbo machmitzin echad hu: 
Eno loke mishshum lo yerae v<small>(Shemot 12 19)</small> "lo yimmatze" ella im ken kana chametz befesach o chimtzo kede sheyyaase bo maase. aval im haya lo chametz kodem happesach uva happesach velo biaro ella hinnicho birshuto af al pi sheavar al shene lavin eno loke min hattora mippene shello asa bo maase. umakkin oto makkat mardut: 
Chametz sheavar alav happesach asur bahanaya leolam. vedavar ze kenas hu middivre sofrim mippene sheavar al bal yerae uval yimmatze asaruhu. afillu hinnicho bishgaga o beones. kede shello yanniach adam chametz birshuto befesach kede sheyyehane bo achar happesach: 
Chametz shennitarev bedavar acher toch happesach ben bemino ben shello bemino hare ze oser bechol shehu. vechametz shel yisrael sheavar alav happesach af al pi shehu asur bahanaya im nitarev ben bemino ben shello bemino hare ze muttar leachlo achar happesach. shello kansu veasru ella bechametz atzmo aval hattaarovet muttar baachila leachar happesach: 
En chayyavin karet ella al achilat atzmo shel chametz aval eruv chametz kegon kutach habbavli veshechar hammadi vechol haddome lahen middevarim shehechametz meorav bahen im achalan befesach loke veen bo karet shenneemar <small>(Shemot 12 20)</small> "kol machmetzet lo tochelu". bamme devarim amurim besheachal kezayit chametz betoch hattaarovet bichde achilat shalosh betzim hu shelloke min hattora. aval im en battaarovet kezayit bichde achilat shalosh betzim af al pi sheasur lo leechol im achal eno loke ella makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Haochel min hechametz atzmo befesach kol shehu hare ze asur min hattora shenneemar <small>(Shemot 13 3)</small> "lo yeachel". veaf al pi chen eno chayyav karet o karban ella al kashshiur shehu kezayit. vehaochel pachot mikkezayit bemezid makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Asur leechol chametz beyom arbaa asar mechatzot hayyom ulemala shehu mittechillat shaa sheviit bayyom. vechol haochel bazzeman hazze loke min hattora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 16 3)</small> "lo tochal alav chametz". kelomar al karban happesach. kach lamdu mippi hashshemua beferush davar ze lo tochal chametz mishshaa sheruya lishchitat happesach shehu <small>(Shemot 12 6)</small> "ben haarbayim" vehu chatzi hayyom: 
Veasru chachamim leechol chametz mittechillat shaa shishshit kede shello yigga beissur tora. umittechillat shaa shishshit yihye hechametz asur baachila uvahanaya kol shaa shishshit middivre sofrim ushear hayyom mishsheviit ulemala min hattora. shaa chamishit en ochlin bah chametz gezera mishshum yom hameunnan shemma yite ben chamishit leshishshit. veeno asur bahanaya beshaa chamishit. lefichach tolin bah teruma velechem toda vechayyotze bahen mechametz shehu kodesh lo ochlin velo sorfin ad shettaggia shaa shishshit vesorfin hakkol: 
Ha lamadta shemmuttar leechol chametz beyom arbaa asar ad sof shaa reviit. veen ochlin beshaa chamishit aval nehenin bo. vehaochel beshaa shishshit makkin oto makkat mardut. vehaochel mittechillat shaa sheviit loke:
